item.title: Kim Jong-un Inspects New Nuclear Material Production Plant, Emphasizes "Exponential Strengthening of Nuclear Force" (김정은, 새 핵물질 생산공장 시찰…“핵무력 기하급수적 강화” 강조)
item.description:
North Korean State Affairs Commission Chairman Kim Jong-un inspected a new nuclear material production plant, presumed to be a uranium enrichment facility, underscoring his commitment to bolstering the nuclear force. <<> The Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) reported on the 4th that Kim visited the newly operational nuclear material production plant the previous day, accompanied by leading officials from the Central Committee's Munitions Industry Department and the Nuclear Weapons Institute. The agency did not disclose the plant's specific location or production capacity. While three known locations for North Korea's uranium enrichment facilities include Yongbyon in North Pyongan Province, Kangseon in Nampo City, and Kusong in North Pyongan Province, there is a possibility that this newly built high-enriched uranium facility in a "fourth region" has been unveiled. <<> Kim inspected the new production process, which incorporates more sophisticated technology than before, reviewing operational targets and production plans. <<> Kim praised the progress, stating that "under the direct guidance of the 8th Central Committee, over the past five years of the nuclear force strengthening course, weapons-grade nuclear material production capacity has reached a level exceeding twice that of the past," and noted that the decisions adopted at major plenary meetings are being accurately implemented. <<> He further announced, "The 9th Party Congress has decided on a new five-year plan for nuclear force strengthening to continuously enhance the country's nuclear war deterrence," adding that "a strategic decision was adopted to further expand nuclear material production capacity and accordingly continue to increase the number of nuclear weapons." Kim also emphasized the "special nature of our revolution, which requires a long-term confrontation with the most brutal adversaries," stressing that nuclear weapons are "the fundamental guarantee that reliably protects the country's sovereignty, interests, and development rights." <<> He reiterated the stance of thoroughly exercising the status of a nuclear state, saying, "The urgency and responsibility of the historic mission to qualitatively, continuously, and acceleratively expand the nuclear war deterrence, a powerful safety device, are further rising." <<> KCNA also reported that an important consultative meeting on nuclear force strengthening was held that day. Kim, delivering key conclusions with explicit action guidelines, stated, "Today, we have updated important numbers in nuclear activities," adding that "tactical and strategic demand aspects have been fully considered in building nuclear deterrence." He described it as "a historic event marking a transformative milestone for advancing nuclear capabilities," adding, "We have finalized the sequence and guarantees for implementing the vast future plan to exponentially strengthen the national nuclear force." <<> According to photos released by North Korean media, the plant was densely lined with cylindrical centrifuges, devices necessary for uranium enrichment. Additionally, materials presumed to contain key plans for nuclear force strengthening on the conference table where Kim sat, along with some attendees, were blurred beyond recognition. <<> Senior Correspondent Park Min-hee minggu@hani.co.kr (김정은 북한 국무위원장이 우라늄 농축 시설로 보이는 새로운 핵물질 생산공장을 시찰하며 핵 무력 강화 의지를 강조했다.)

item.title: Kim Byung-wook, Former Political Affairs Secretary, Loses Seongnam Mayoral Race (정무비서관 출신 김병욱, 성남시장 선거에서 고배)
item.description:
Kim Byung-wook, a former presidential secretary for political affairs and a member of the original "pro-Lee Jae-myung" faction group known as the "Group of Seven," failed to reclaim the Seongnam mayoral seat. Given that President Lee Jae-myung previously served as Seongnam's mayor, the ruling camp is taking this as a disappointing outcome. (원조 친이재명계(친명) 모임인 7인회 멤버였던 김병욱 전 청와대 정무비서관이 성남시장을 탈환하는 데 실패했다. 이재명 대통령이 과거 성남시장을 지냈다는 점에서 특히 여권은 아쉬운 결과로 받아들이는 분위기다.)

With 99.91% of the vote counted in the Seongnam mayoral election on the 4th, Democratic Party candidate Kim Byung-wook (48.7%) lost to People Power Party candidate Shin Sang-jin (50.3%) by a margin of 1.6 percentage points. Progressive Party candidate Jang Ji-hwa secured 1% of the vote. ( 4일 성남시장 선거의 개표율이 99.91%인 가운데, 김병욱 더불어민주당 후보(48.7%)는 신상진 국민의힘 후보(50.3%)에 1.6%포인트 차이로 패했다. 장지화 진보당 후보는 1%를 득표했다. )

Candidate Kim, a member of the original pro-Lee faction "Group of Seven," previously served as a lawmaker for Seongnam's Bundang-gu district in the 20th and 21st National Assemblies. Under the Lee Jae-myung administration, he served as a presidential secretary for political affairs. ( 김 후보는 원조 친명 모임 7인회 출신으로 20~21대 성남 분당을 국회의원을 지냈다. 이재명 정부 들어 청와대 정무비서관을 지냈다. )

Reporter Ko Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr ( 고한솔 기자 sol@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Oh Se-hoon Wins Fifth Term as Seoul Mayor… Late Comeback Victory Over Jung Won-oh (오세훈, 서울시장 5선 성공…정원오에 막판 역전승)
item.description:
Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party candidate, was elected in the June 3 local elections for Seoul mayor, becoming the first person to achieve a fifth term in that office. As of 9:30 a.m. on the 4th, with 97.70% of the votes counted, Oh secured 48.94% of the vote, overtaking Jung Won-oh of the Democratic Party of Korea, who received 48.34%. Jung conceded defeat around 9:30 a.m. (오세훈 국민의힘 후보가 6·3 지방선거 서울시장 선거에 당선되면서 최초 5선 서울시장 고지에 올랐다. 오 후보는 4일 오전 9시30분 개표 상황(개표율 97.70%)에서 48.94%의 득표율로 48.34%를 그친 정원오 더불어민주당 후보에 역전승을 거뒀다. 정 후보는 오전 9시30분께 승복 선언을 했다.)

Oh served his first and second terms as Seoul mayor from 2006 to 2011, followed by his third and fourth terms starting in 2021. During this election period, he distanced himself from the People Power Party leadership under Jang Dong-hyuk and deployed a strategy leveraging his incumbency advantage and high recognition. As a non-mainstream faction member, Oh is expected to serve as a focal point for conservative realignment while also strengthening his position as a leading conservative presidential candidate. (오 후보는 2006~20011년 서울시장 초·재선을, 지난 2021년부터 3·4선을 지냈다. 이번 선거 기간 장동혁 국민의힘 지도부와 거리를 두고, 자신이 지닌 현역 시장 프리미엄과 높은 인지도를 앞세우는 전략을 폈다. 비당권파인 오 후보는 앞으로 보수 재편의 구심점으로 역할하는 한편, 보수 유력 대선 주자로서의 발판도 다지게 됐다.)

Oh's victory over Jung in a fiercely contested race is seen as reflecting voter sentiment to check the Lee Jae-myung administration and concerns over real estate issues among Seoul residents. (오 후보가 치열한 접전 양상 속에 정 후보를 누른 것은 이재명 정부 견제 심리와 서울 시민들의 부동산 민심 등이 반영된 결과로 풀이된다.)

Lee Ji-eun, Reporter jieuny@hani.co.kr Jang Na-rae, Reporter wing@hani.co.kr (이지은 기자 jieuny@hani.co.kr 장나래 기자 wing@hani.co.kr)

item.title: "Fuel for Election Fraud Forces"…Progressive and Justice Party Call for Resignation of Election Commission Chair (“부정선거 세력에 빌미”…진보·정의당, 선관위원장 사퇴 촉구)
item.description:
On the day of the main vote for the June 3 local elections, when an unprecedented incident of ballot shortages occurred at some polling stations in Seoul on the 3rd, the Progressive Party and the Justice Party urged the resignation of Noh Tae-ak, chair of the National Election Commission (NEC), citing that this provided a pretext for those advocating "election fraud conspiracy theories." (6·3 지방선거 본투표일인 3일 서울 일부 투표소에서 투표용지 부족이라는 초유의 사태가 발생하자 진보당과 정의당은 ‘부정선거 음모론’을 주장하는 이들에게 빌미를 제공했다며 노태악 중앙선거관리위원회(선관위) 위원장의 사퇴를 촉구했다.)

The Progressive Party, in a briefing by Deputy Spokesperson Park Tae-woo on the 4th, pointed out, "What kind of times are these? It's a sensitive moment where forces plotting 'election fraud conspiracy theories' at every opportunity are wide-eyed and ready to shake the election results," adding, "In such a grave situation, the NEC, which oversees national election affairs, has instead sparked controversy with absurd mismanagement." (진보당은 4일 박태우 부대변인 브리핑에서 “지금이 어느 때냐. 틈만 나면 ‘부정선거 음모론’을 획책하며 선거 결과를 흔들려는 세력이 시퍼렇게 눈을 뜨고 있는 예민한 시국”이라며 “이러한 엄중한 상황에서 국가 선거 사무를 총괄하는 선관위가 도리어 황당한 부실 관리로 논란의 불씨를 지폈다”고 짚었다.)

Deputy Spokesperson Park said, "How can we tell the public to trust the fairness of elections with this?" and "We strongly denounce the NEC's behavior, which has sent the trust in elections, the foundation of democracy, plummeting to rock bottom." (박 부대변인은 “이래서야 어떻게 국민에게 선거의 공정성을 믿으라 말할 수 있겠냐”며 “민주주의의 근간인 선거 신뢰도를 밑바닥까지 추락시킨 선관위의 행태를 강력히 규탄한다”고 했다.)

He continued, "This incident has become a perfect excuse for the People Power Party and far-right forces," adding, "As if they were waiting, the People Power Party has gone all out, talking about 'stopping the vote counting' and 'filing election invalidation lawsuits,' inciting election rejection, while far-right forces have even staged surprise late-night protests, spreading election fraud conspiracy theories." (이어 “이번 사태는 국민의힘과 극우 세력에게 훌륭한 핑곗거리가 됐다”며 “국민의힘은 기다렸다는 듯 총력을 다해 ‘개표 중단’과 ‘선거무효 소송’을 운운하며 선거 불복 선동에 나섰고, 극우 세력들은 심야 기습 시위까지 벌이며 부정선거 음모론을 확산시키고 있다”고 했다.)

Deputy Spokesperson Park emphasized, "The one who provided these forces with a decisive pretext was none other than the NEC," and demanded, "We call for the immediate resignation of Noh Tae-ak, the NEC chair, and the entire leadership who allowed this situation to happen." (박 부대변인은 “이들에게 결정적 빌미를 제공한 것은 다름 아닌 선관위”라며 “사태를 이 지경으로 만든 노태악 선관위원장을 비롯한 지도부 전원의 즉각적인 사퇴를 요구한다”고 덧붙였다.)

The Justice Party also strongly criticized the NEC. (정의당도 선관위를 강하게 비판했다.)

In a statement on the 3rd, the Justice Party said, "With this incident, the nearly dead People Power Party has rallied and is demanding a postponement of the election," and "The NEC has not only failed to properly ensure the fairness of the election but has provided the worst possible pretext to election fraud conspiracy theorists, including Hwang Kyo-ahn." (정의당은 3일 성명에서 “이번 사태로 다 죽어가던 국민의힘이 결집해 선거 연기를 요구하고 있다”며 “선관위는 선거의 공정성을 제대로 세우기는커녕 황교안을 비롯한 부정선거 음모론자들에게 최악의 빌미를 제공했다”고 했다.)

The Justice Party expressed, "We deeply regret that such an incident occurred at a critical time when we should be uprooting the insurrection forces and completely eliminating conspiracy theorists," and urged, "Noh Tae-ak, the NEC chair, should resign immediately." (정의당은 “내란 세력의 뿌리를 뽑고 음모론자들을 완전히 퇴출시켜야 할 중요한 시점에 이런 사태가 벌어진 것에 매우 큰 유감을 표한다”며 “노태악 선관위원장은 즉각 사퇴하라”고 촉구했다.)

The Justice Party added, addressing the People Power Party, "The People Power Party, including Representative Jang Dong-hyuk, who is spreading conspiracy theories again using this incident as a pretext, should exercise restraint," and "The public is clearly watching the true colors of an incompetent party that has nothing to rely on but election fraud conspiracy theories." (정의당은 국민의힘을 향해 “이번 사태를 빌미 삼아 다시 음모론을 확산하고 있는 장동혁 대표를 비롯한 국민의힘은 자중하라”며 “기댈 곳이 부정선거 음모론뿐인 무능한 정당의 민낯을 국민들은 똑똑히 지켜보고 있다”고 덧붙였다.)

Reporter Song Kyung-hwa freehwa@hani.co.kr (송경화 기자 freehwa@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Won-oh Jeong Concedes Defeat: “Everything is My Fault… I Humbly Accept the Citizens’ Choice” (정원오 패배 승복 “모든 것이 제 탓…시민 선택 겸허히 받들 것”)
item.description:
Won-oh Jeong, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate for Seoul mayor who lost in the June 3 local elections, declared his concession, stating, “I will solemnly and humbly accept the choice of the citizens,” and “I was lacking. Everything is my fault.” (6·3 지방선거 서울시장 선거에서 낙선한 정원오 더불어민주당 서울시장 후보는 “시민 여러분의 선택을 무겁고 겸허히 받들겠다”며 “제가 부족했다. 모든 것이 제 탓이다”라고 승복을 선언했다.)

At around 9:30 AM on the 4th, at his election office on Sejong-daero in Jung-gu, Seoul, Candidate Jeong said, “I failed to get closer and listen more deeply,” and “I failed to win broader hearts.” He added, “To the citizens who trusted and stood by me, the campaign staff, volunteers, camp associates, and fellow party members, I am sorry for not living up to your expectations,” while also expressing, “I extend my congratulations to the elected candidate, Se-hoon Oh.” (정 후보는 4일 오전 9시30분께 서울 중구 세종대로에 있는 선거 사무소에서 “더 가까이 다가가지 못했고, 더 깊이 듣지 못했다”면서 “더 넓게 마음을 얻지 못했다”라고 했다. 이어 “저를 믿고 함께해 주신 시민 여러분, 선거 운동원과 자원봉사자, 또 캠프 관계자, 당원 동지 여러분께 기대에 보답하지 못해 송구하다”면서도 “당선된 오세훈 후보께 축하의 말씀을 전한다”고 덧붙였다.)

Candidate Jeong lost to Se-hoon Oh of the People Power Party, who received 48.94% of the vote compared to Jeong’s 48.34% in the ballot counting as of 9:30 AM that day (with 97.70% of ballots counted). (정 후보는 이날 오전 9시30분 개표 상황(개표율 97.70%)에서 48.34%를 득표해 48.94%를 득표한 오세훈 국민의힘 후보에게 패했다.)

Reporter Hye-min Jeong jhm@hani.co.kr Reporter Hae-jeong Kim sea@hani.co.kr (정혜민 기자 jhm@hani.co.kr 김해정 기자 sea@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Oh Se-hoon: "Citizens Left a Safety Valve for Democracy... The Ballot Paper Problem Cannot Be Buried" (오세훈 “시민이 민주주의 안전판 남겼다…투표지 문제, 묻어둘 순 없어”)
item.description:
Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party candidate for Seoul mayor, expressed his election victory sentiment on the 4th, saying, "It is a victory of common sense," and "The citizens have left Seoul as the last safety valve of democracy so that the Republic of Korea does not tilt completely to one side." However, regarding the shortage of ballot papers that occurred in Seoul's Songpa District and elsewhere, he stated, "Just because the citizens created a great victory doesn't mean we can bury this serious defect that occurred in the process as if nothing happened." <<> Oh, wearing a suit and a red tie, appeared at his campaign office in Jongno-gu, Seoul, around 9:50 a.m. that day and said, "Seoul's future has brightened. A bright green light has also been turned on for the quality of life of Seoul citizens," adding, "I do not consider this election result to be a personal victory for me, Oh Se-hoon." <<> Oh said, "The citizens have firmly re-established the great principle of checks and balances," and "The citizens have shown that no power can reign above the law and no administration can stand above the people. I extend my deep respect and gratitude to the citizens who have preserved the balance of democracy in the name of Seoul." <<> Regarding the shortage of ballot papers, Oh stated, "The process is as important as the result," and "There was confusion at polling places throughout Seoul. As a candidate, I express deep regret over the infringement on the citizens' right to vote, which is the most basic and sacred right of democracy." He added, "We must thoroughly investigate what the problem was, and there must be corresponding strict accountability and fundamental improvements." <<> Oh said, "I will surely repay you with greater change and better results than the past five years," and "I will humbly embrace the voices that did not support me as a whip to work harder." He added, "Now it's time to get back to work," and "I will immediately return to city administration and solve the problems that weigh down the citizens' lives one by one." Regarding the collapse of the Seosomun Elevated Road in Seoul during the election period, he stated, "As soon as I return to work, I will launch a high-intensity special safety inspection of all aging infrastructure and construction sites in Seoul." <<> At the same time, with 97.7% of the vote counting completed in the Seoul mayoral election, Oh received 2,501,865 votes (48.9%), leading Jeong Won-oh, the Democratic Party candidate who received 2,471,506 votes (48.3%), by 33,359 votes. With most of the vote counting completed in 25 autonomous districts in Seoul, the vote counting rate in Songpa District, where the ballot paper shortage occurred, is at 75.6%, the slowest. Songpa District has a relatively strong support base for the People Power Party, and analysts say Oh has solidified his lead. <<> Reporter Kim Hae-jung sea@hani.co.kr Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr (오세훈 국민의힘 서울시장 후보가 4일 “상식의 승리”라며 “시민 여러분께서 대한민국이 한쪽으로 완전히 기울지 않도록 서울을 민주주의의 마지막 안전판을 남겼다”고 당선 소감을 밝혔다. 다만 오 후보는 서울 송파구 등에서 발생한 투표용지 부족 사태에 대해선 “시민들이 위대한 승리를 만들어 줬다고해서 그 과정에서 발생한 이 중대한 결함까지 아무 일 없었던 것처럼 묻어둘 수 없다”고 했다.)

item.title: Jung Cheong-rae: "It Hurts We Couldn't Reclaim Seoul... Grateful to the People Who Brought a Nationwide Victory" (정청래 “서울 탈환 못해 아프다…전국적 승리 안긴 국민께 감사”)
item.description:
Jung Cheong-rae, leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, expressed regarding the results of the June 3 local elections and parliamentary by-elections, "I deeply thank the people who gave the Democratic Party a great victory nationwide," while also stating, "It hurts that we couldn't reclaim Seoul." (정청래 더불어민주당 대표가 6·3 지방선거 및 국회의원 재보궐 선거 결과에 대해 “전국적으로 민주당에 큰 승리를 안겨주신 국민 여러분께 깊이 감사드린다”면서도 “서울을 탈환하지 못해 아프다”라고 밝혔다.)

At a press conference held at the National Assembly on the morning of the 4th, Leader Jung said, "With this victory in the June 3 local elections, the Lee Jae-myung administration can now carry out stable state affairs. We were able to win thanks to President Lee Jae-myung." Leader Jung maintained a stern expression throughout the press conference. (정 대표는 4일 오전 국회에서 기자회견을 열고 “이번 6·3 지방선거 승리로 이재명 정부가 안정적인 국정 운영을 할 수 있게 됐다. 이재명 대통령 덕분에 승리할 수 있었다”고 말했다. 정 대표는 기자회견 내내 굳은 표정을 유지했다.)

Furthermore, Leader Jung said, "I offer my deepest condolences to the candidates who gave their all but unfortunately lost," mentioning candidate Oh Joong-ki, who ran for Gyeongsangbuk-do governor, and candidate Kim Boo-kyum, who ran for Daegu mayor. Following this, Leader Jung congratulated the winners of 12 metropolitan and provincial government head positions, including Gyeonggi Province Governor-elect Choo Mi-ae, by calling out their names. "There were also many strong performances in the elections for basic local government heads, such as the mayor of Gangneung City in Gangwon Province, where the Democratic Party had never won before," he said. (또 정 대표는 “혼신을 다했지만, 아쉽게 패배하신 후보자들께 깊은 위로의 마음을 전한다”라며 경북도지사에 도전했던 오중기 후보와 대구시장에 도전했던 김부겸 후보를 거론했다. 이어 정 대표는 추미애 경기도지사 당선자 등 12곳 광역자치단체장 당선자를 호명하며 축하를 전했다. 정 대표는 “한 번도 (민주당이) 당선되지 못했던 강원도 강릉시장 등 기초단체장 선거에서도 많은 선전이 있었다”고 했다.)

Leader Jung stated, "I am especially deeply grateful to the members of the Progressive Party for rallying the momentum for victory through the unification of the Ulsan mayoral candidate," and added, "We will seriously consider and study future methods of alliance with other parties, including the introduction of a runoff voting system." (정 대표는 “특히 울산시장 후보 단일화를 통해 승리의 기세를 모아주신 진보당 당원 여러분들께도 깊이 감사드린다”라며 “(결선투표제 도입 등) 다른 당과의 연대 방법에 대해서도 앞으로 깊이 고민, 연구하도록 하겠다”고 말했다.)

item.title: People Power Party, Which Had Urged a 'Seoul By-Election', Goes Silent After Oh Se-hoon Wins (“서울 재선거” 촉구하던 국힘…오세훈 당선되자 ‘입꾹’)
item.description:
The People Power Party (PPP), which had strongly demanded a "by-election" after ballot shortages occurred at some polling stations in Seoul on the 3rd, the main voting day for the June 3 local elections, is now backing off. Unlike the exit poll results from three broadcasters on the evening of the 3rd, which showed Jeong Won-oh, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate for Seoul mayor, in the lead, the party is refraining from further comments after Oh Se-hoon, the PPP candidate, was elected as Seoul mayor on the morning of the 4th. (6·3 지방선거 본투표일인 3일 서울 일부 투표소에서 투표용지 부족 사태가 발생하자 “재선거”를 강력히 촉구했던 국민의힘이 주춤하고 있다. 정원오 더불어민주당 서울시장 후보가 앞섰던 3일 저녁 방송3사 출구조사 결과와 달리, 4일 오전 오세훈 국민의힘 후보가 서울시장 선거에 당선되자 말을 아끼는 모양새다.)

PPP Floor Leader Song Eon-seok held an "urgent press briefing on the ballot shortage" at the PPP's central party office in Yeouido, Seoul, at 8:55 p.m. on the 3rd, calling for a halt to the vote counting in the Seoul election. (송언석 국민의힘 원내대표는 3일 저녁 8시55분 서울 여의도 국민의힘 중앙당사에서 ‘투표용지 부족 관련 긴급 기자간담회’를 열어 서울 선거에 대한 개표 중단을 촉구했다.)

Floor Leader Song stated, "We ask that the vote counting for the Seoul election be stopped immediately. We formally request a postponement of the election, in accordance with Article 196 of the Public Official Election Act." He added, "There was a case where the German Constitutional Court declared a by-election in Berlin completely invalid and ordered a re-vote because the overall mismanagement by the election authorities hindered the exercise of voting rights and distorted the election results. We will also announce our position on damage situations in other areas, such as Incheon, as soon as they are identified." PPP Leader Jang Dong-hyuk also held a briefing at 9:30 p.m. on the 3rd, saying, "This Seoul voting is an election where voters' right to vote and political rights were seriously violated. The fairness of the vote has already been broken. We must stop the counting immediately until the truth is investigated and, depending on the results, hold the election again." (송 원내대표는 “서울 선거 개표, 지금 즉시 중단하기 바란다. 공직선거법 제196조에 의거해서 선거를 연기할 것을 정식으로 요구하는바”라고 말했다. 이어 “독일 베를린 지방선거에서 독일 헌법재판소가 선거 당국의 총체적 부실 운영이 투표권 행사를 방해하고 선거 결과를 왜곡했다는 사유로 선거 전면 무효를 선언하고 재투표를 명령한 사례가 있었다”며 “서울뿐만 아니라 인천 등 다른 지역에 대해서도 피해 상황을 파악하는 대로 입장을 내도록 하겠다”고 했다. 장동혁 국민의힘 대표도 3일 밤 9시30분 브리핑을 열어 “이번 서울시 투표는 유권자 투표권과 참정권이 심각하게 침해된 선거다. 이미 투표의 공정성은 깨졌다”며 “지금이라도 진상 파악이 이뤄질 때까지 즉시 개표를 중단하고, 결과에 따라 다시 선거를 실시해야만 한다”고 말했다.)

However, in a statement issued by Floor Leader Song on the morning of the 4th, after the election results were confirmed, he said, "We humbly accept the will of the people expressed through the June 3 local elections," without mentioning a "by-election." (그런데 선거 결과가 확정된 4일 오전에 송 원내대표가 낸 입장문에서는 “6·3 지방선거로 표출된 국민의 뜻을 겸허히 수용한다”며 ‘재선거’는 거론되지 않았다.)

Floor Leader Song stated, "Regardless of the election results, the ballot shortages in Seoul, Incheon, Hwaseong, Gyeonggi, and other areas are serious incidents that severely violated the people's right to vote. We will devise strong preventive measures, including investigating the truth of the matter, punishing those responsible, and implementing external controls on the National Election Commission." (송 원내대표는 “선거 결과와 무관하게 서울, 인천, 경기 화성 등지에서 발생한 투표용지 부족 사태는 국민의 투표권을 심각하게 침해한 중대한 사건”이라면서 “사건의 진상 규명과 책임자 처벌, 그리고 선관위에 대한 외부 통제 방안 등 강력한 재발방지책을 강구하겠다”고 했다.)

PPP lawmaker Na Kyung-won, who posted on Facebook on the night of the 3rd, "Stop the vote counting immediately and declare a 'by-election'," has not posted any further updates since. Na had previously shared the Berlin case, urging, "Like the German ruling, a by-election must be held unconditionally, regardless of its impact on victory or defeat." (3일 밤 “즉각 개표를 중단하고 ‘재선거’를 선언하라”고 페이스북에 올렸던 나경원 국민의힘 의원은 이후 추가 게시물을 올리지 않고 있다. 나 의원 역시 베를린 사례를 공유하며 “독일 판결처럼 승패 영향과 상관없이 무조건 재선거해야 한다”고 촉구한 바 있다.)

PPP lawmaker Kim Eun-hye, who posted on Facebook at 2:10 a.m. on the 4th, "Stop counting immediately and declare a by-election," also has no subsequent posts. (4일 새벽 2시10분 “즉각 개표 중단, 재선거를 선언하십시오”라고 페이스북에 올린 김은혜 국민의힘 의원도 마찬가지로 이후 게시물이 없는 상태다.)

Democratic Party lawmaker Jeon Yong-gi, after criticizing the National Election Commission at a party policy coordination meeting on the morning of the 4th, added, "However, the PPP's attitude of shaking the democratic system itself to gain political advantage, using the NEC's administrative errors as a pretext, is an even more serious problem." (전용기 더불어민주당 의원은 4일 오전 열린 당 정책조정회의에서 선관위를 비판한 뒤 “그러나 선관위의 행정 실책을 빌미로 민주주의 시스템 자체를 흔들며 정략적 이익을 챙기려는 국민의힘의 태도는 더욱 심각한 문제”라고 비판했다.)

Lawmaker Jeon said, "Yesterday, the PPP leadership, including leader Jang Dong-hyuk, even mentioned stopping the Seoul count and the possibility of a by-election. I ask the PPP: Do you still insist on a re-vote now that the counting is over? Will you proceed with a lawsuit?" (전 의원은 “국민의힘 장동혁 대표를 비롯한 지도부는 어제 서울 개표 중단과 재선거 가능성까지 거론했다”며 “국민의힘에 묻겠다. 개표가 끝난 지금도 재투표를 주장하나? 소송을 진행하실 거냐”고 물었다.)

Jeon added, "You initially requested a stop to counting and a re-vote, but now that the results are out, what is your position? Please make it clear now." (전 의원은 “처음에는 개표 중단과 재투표를 요청하더니, 결과가 나온 지금은 어떤 입장이냐? 이제 분명히 밝혀보시기 바란다”고 덧붙였다.)

At 6 p.m. on the 3rd, exit polls from three terrestrial broadcasters showed candidate Jeong leading candidate Oh by 5.4 percentage points. However, as the gap began to narrow past 7 a.m. on the 4th, the tide reversed around 7:16 a.m., and Oh's victory was confirmed. (지난 3일 저녁 6시 지상파 방송 3사의 출구조사 결과 정 후보가 오 후보를 5.4%포인트 앞서는 것으로 나타났다. 그런데 4일 오전 7시를 넘어서면서 표 차이가 줄기 시작했고, 7시16분께 지지율이 역전되더니 오 후보의 승리가 확정됐다.)

Reporter Song Kyung-hwa freehwa@hani.co.kr (송경화 기자 freehwa@hani.co.kr)

item.title: [Photo] 'Cheers and Silence'… Oh Se-hoon Returns to Seoul City Hall, Jung Won-oh Bows His Head ([포토] ‘환호와 침묵’…다시 서울시청 간 오세훈, 고개 숙인 정원오)
item.description:
Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party candidate for Seoul mayor, has won the June 3 local elections, succeeding in his fifth-term bid. Starting to lead Democrat Party candidate Jung Won-oh around 7:41 a.m. on the 4th (with a vote count rate of 95.1%), Oh secured a comeback victory with a 49.08% vote share by 11 a.m. (vote count rate of 98.86%). Jung Won-oh conceded defeat at 9:30 a.m., and Oh Se-hoon, after announcing his acceptance speech at 10 a.m. at his campaign office in Jongno-gu, Seoul, saying, "I will pour all my experience and capabilities into Seoul for the last four years granted by the citizens," walked to Seoul City Hall in Jung-gu, Seoul. (오세훈 서울시장 국민의힘 후보가 6·3 지방선거에 당선돼 5선 도전에 성공했다. 4일 오전 7시41분(개표율 95.1%)께 상황에서 정원오 더불어민주당 후보를 앞서기 시작한 오 후보는 오전 11시 개표 상황(개표율 98.86%)에서 49.08% 득표율로 역전승을 거뒀다. 정원오 후보는 오전 9시30분 승복 선언을 했고, 오세훈 후보는 오전 10시 서울 종로구 캠프 사무소에서 “시민 여러분이 허락해주신 마지막 4년, 제 모든 경험과 역량을 서울을 위해 쏟아붓겠다”라며 당선 소감을 발표한 다음 걸어서 서울 중구 서울시청 청사로 이동했다.)

At the entrance of the city hall, Oh Se-hoon responded with a bright smile to the cheers and congratulations from employees. Oh said, "The first thing to attend to is the missing rebar incident at Samsung Station," adding, "There were some distorted aspects during the election phase." Upon entering the lobby and receiving a bouquet from employees, Oh advised them, "I promised the citizens during the election period to create a 'Seoul Metropolitan City where we can enjoy a warmer and healthier quality of life by working together with you.' I would appreciate it if you could join your hearts to faithfully keep that promise." (청사 들머리에서 오세훈 후보는 직원들의 환호와 축하 인사에 환한 미소로 답했다. 오 후보는 “바로 들어가 챙길일은 일단 삼성역 철근누락 사건”이라고 말하며 “선거국면에 왜곡된 측면있다”고 한번 더 짚고 넘어갔다. 1층 로비에 들어서서 직원들에게 꽃다발을 받은 오세훈 후보는 “여러분과 함께 호흡 맞춰서 ‘더 따뜻하고 더 건강한 삶의질을 누릴 수 있는 서울특별시 만들겠다’고 선거 기간동안 시민들께 약속했다”며 “그 약속 충실히 지키도록 여러분 함께 마음 모아주시면 감사하겠다”고 직원들에게 당부했다.)

Meanwhile, amid controversies such as some polling stations extending voting hours until 10 p.m. due to a shortage of ballots on the main voting day of the June 3 local elections, Jung Won-oh, the defeated Democrat Party candidate for Seoul mayor, conceded defeat at his election office on Sejong-daero in Jung-gu, Seoul, around 9:30 a.m. on the 4th, stating, "I will humbly and respectfully accept the citizens' choice." Here is a compilation of photos from the scene. (한편 6·3 지방선거 본투표일에 투표용지 부족으로 일부 투표소의 투표 시간이 오후 10시까지 연장되는 등 논란이 이어지는 가운데, 서울시장 선거에서 낙선한 정원오 더불어민주당 서울시장 후보는 4일 오전 9시30분께 서울 중구 세종대로에 있는 선거 사무소에서 “시민 여러분의 선택을 무겁고 겸허히 받들겠다”며 승복을 선언했다. 현장의 사진을 모아본다.)

Reporter Kim Hye-yoon unique@hani.co.kr (김혜윤 기자 unique@hani.co.kr)

item.title: 'Ballot Paper Shortage' Election Commission Announces "Fact-Finding Committee Centered on External Figures" (‘투표용지 부족 사태’ 선관위 “외부 인사 위주 진상규명위 설치”)
item.description:
The National Election Commission announced on the 4th that it will establish a fact-finding committee composed mainly of external figures to investigate the ballot paper shortage that occurred at some polling stations in Seoul during the June 3 local elections and will prepare measures to prevent recurrence. (중앙선거관리위원회가 6·3 지방선거 서울 일부 투표소에서 벌어진 투표용지 부족 사태에 대해 외부 인사 위주로 구성된 진상규명위원회를 설치하고 재발방지 대책을 마련하겠다고 4일 밝혔다.)

On the 4th, the National Election Commission issued a statement saying, "Through a full commission meeting held early this morning, it was decided that as soon as the vote counting for the 9th local elections is completed, we will make every possible effort to investigate the causes of this incident and prepare measures to prevent recurrence," adding, "In accordance with this decision, we plan to analyze the voting records of the affected polling stations and verify the on-site situation at the time from voting supervisors and clerks." (4일 중앙선관위는 입장문을 내어 “이날 새벽 개최된 전체위원회의를 통해 제9회 지방선거 개표가 종료되는대로 즉시 이번 사태에 대한 진상 규명 및 재발방지 대책을 마련하기 위해 가능한 최선의 노력을 다 하기로 결정한 바 있다”며 “이 결정에 따라 해당 투표소의 투표록 등을 분석하고 투표관리관 및 사무원 등으로부터 당시 현장 상황을 확인할 예정”이라고 했다.)

The National Election Commission also stated, "To identify the causes of the ballot shortage incident and prepare measures to prevent recurrence, we will establish and operate a fact-finding committee composed mainly of external experts." (또 중앙선관위는 “투표지 부족 사태 원인 파악과 재발방지 대책 마련을 위하여 외부전문가 위주로 구성한 진상규명위원회를 설치·운영한다”고 했다.)

Meanwhile, the National Election Commission said, "To determine the winners for the Seoul metropolitan area and Songpa-gu electoral districts, the Seoul Metropolitan Election Commission must visit the Jamsil 7-dong 2nd polling station and open the ballot box, as only then can the winners for those electoral districts be determined," adding, "We are currently persuading the citizens present at the polling station." (한편, 중앙선관위는 “서울시 및 송파구 선거구 당선인을 결정하기 위해 서울시 선관위가 잠실7동 제2투표소를 방문해 투표함을 개함해야 해당 선거구의 당선인 결정이 가능하다”며 “현재 투표소에서 있는 시민들을 설득하고 있다”고 했다.)

At the Jamsil 7-dong 2nd polling station in Songpa-gu, after the ballot paper shortage, a gathered crowd has been asserting the invalidity of the election and maintaining a blockade, preventing the ballot box from being removed. (송파구 잠실7동 제2투표소에서는 투표용지 부족 사태 이후 모인 시위대가 선거 무효를 주장하고 봉쇄를 이어가면서 투표함 반출이 이뤄지지 못하고 있다.)

The National Election Commission announced that as soon as it becomes possible to transport the ballot box, it will be moved to the Songpa-gu Election Commission's vote-counting site set up at the Seoul Olympic Park Handball Stadium, and the vote counting will proceed under the observation of counting witnesses to determine the winners. item.title: President Lee: "Shortage of Ballot Papers... Deeply Regrettable, Those Responsible Must Be Held Accountable" (이 대통령 “투표용지 부족…매우 큰 유감, 책임 물어야”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung on the 4th expressed "deep regret" regarding the "ballot paper shortage incident," stating that "it is hard to accept such a flaw in election management, which should be the most meticulous aspect of a democratic republic." (이재명 대통령이 4일 ‘투표용지 부족 사태’와 관련해 “민주공화국에서 무엇보다 철저해야 할 선거 관리에 납득하기 쉽지 않은 허점이 발생한 데 대해 매우 큰 유감을 표한다”고 말했다.)

Speaking at a meeting of senior secretaries held at the Blue House, President Lee said, "All state institutions have a duty to make thorough preparations to ensure there is not even the slightest lapse in the exercise of the people's sacred political rights. However, it is said that residents in some areas experienced significant confusion and inconvenience due to a shortage of ballot papers." This situation occurred during the main voting of the June 3 local elections the previous day, where some areas, including Jamsil in Seoul, saw voters unable to cast their ballots due to a lack of ballot papers, forcing them to return or wait. (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 수석보좌관 회의에서 “모든 국가기관은 국민의 신성한 참정권 행사 과정에서 조금의 빈틈이 없도록 만반의 준비를 해야 할 책무가 있다. 그런데 일부 지역에서 투표용지 부족으로 주민들이 큰 혼란과 불편을 겪었다고 한다”며 이렇게 말했다. 전날 치러진 6·3 지방선거 본투표에서 서울 잠실 등 일부 지역에서 투표용지 부족으로 투표를 하지 못해 돌아가거나 대기하는 사태가 벌어졌다.)

President Lee stated, "The relevant authorities must use all the responsibilities and powers of the executive branch to clearly identify the cause of the problem and, if there is anyone to hold accountable, they should be held responsible. I hope they will prepare reliable and appropriate measures to ensure that the infringement of political rights does not happen again." (이 대통령은 “관계기관은 행정부가 가진 책임과 권한을 모두 사용해 문제 발생 이유를 명확히 밝히고, 책임질 게 있으면 책임을 물어야 한다”며 “참정권이 훼손되는 일이 다시는 발생하지 않도록 신뢰할 만한 적절한 대책을 마련해주길 바란다”고 말했다.)

The day also marked the first anniversary of President Lee's inauguration. President Lee remarked, "It seems it has already been a year since my inauguration. The local elections happened to fall on this day, and now the local elections are over. I congratulate those who were elected and offer words of consolation to those who faced disappointing results." He continued, "The ruling and opposition parties are partners who, on behalf of the sovereign, must protect the people's lives and pioneer the nation's future. Now that the elections are over, I hope the political sphere will unite efforts for improving people's livelihoods, balanced regional development, and national unity. The government will also humbly uphold the people's will and actively cooperate with local governments, regardless of their affiliated parties." (이날은 이 대통령이 취임 1주년을 맞는 날이기도 했다. 이 대통령은 “벌써 오늘로 취임 1주년이 된 거 같다. 하필 지방선거가 있었고, 이제 지방선거는 끝났다”며 “당선된 분들은 축하드리고 아쉬운 결과를 안게 된 분들은 위로의 말씀을 드린다”고 말했다. 이 대통령은 이어 “여야는 주권자를 대리해 국민의 삶을 지키고 국가의 내일을 개척해야 할 동반자”라며 “선거가 끝난 만큼 정치권도 민생개선과 지역균형발전, 국민 통합에 힘을 모아주길 바란다. 정부도 국민의 뜻을 겸허하게 받들어 소속 정당 여부와 관계없이 지방정부와 적극적으로 협력하겠다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: First Democratic Mayor of Gangneung, By His Side a Singer Son Who Faced 'Far-Right' Hate Comments (첫 ‘민주’ 강릉시장, 그 옆엔 ‘극우 악플’ 받던 가수 아들)
item.description:
Kim Joong-nam, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate and father of former idol singer Fromtwenty (real name Kim Rae-hwan), was elected mayor of Gangneung. This marks the first time a Democratic Party candidate has won the mayoral election since the introduction of local autonomy 31 years ago. Fromtwenty had previously faced a barrage of harsh comments from far-right netizens after campaigning for his father. (아이돌 출신 가수 프롬트웬티(본명 김래환) 부친 김중남 더불어민주당 후보가 강릉시장에 당선됐다. 강릉시장에 민주당 후보가 당선된 건 민선 지방자치제 도입 이후 31년 만에 처음이다. 프롬트웬티는 아버지 선거 운동에 나섰다가 극우 누리꾼들로부터 댓글 공격을 받은 바 있다.)

In the June 3 local election for Gangneung mayor, candidate Kim secured 51.19% of the vote, defeating the incumbent mayor Kim Hong-gyu of the People Power Party (42.53%) and others, confirming his victory. The Gangneung mayoral election has historically shown a strong conservative voting pattern, with candidates from the Democratic Liberal Party, Grand National Party, Saenuri Party, Liberty Korea Party, and People Power Party winning consecutively since the introduction of local autonomy in 1995, but this time it was overturned for the first time. (6·3 지방선거 강릉시장 선거에서 김 후보가 51.19%의 지지율로 현직 시장인 김홍규 국민의힘 후보(42.53%) 등을 누르고 당선을 확정 지었다. 강릉시장 선거에선 1995년 민선 지방자치제 도입 뒤 민주자유당, 한나라당, 새누리당, 자유한국당, 국민의힘 후보가 연달아 당선됐을 만큼 보수적인 투표 성향이 강했는데, 이번에 처음 뒤집혔다.)

A former civil servant of Gangneung City who experienced dismissal and reinstatement during his activities in the civil servants' union, the elected candidate Kim was elected chairman of the Korean Government Employees' Union in 2012 and continued his labor activism. He ran as a Democratic Party candidate in the Gangneung constituency for the 22nd general election in 2024 but was defeated by People Power Party lawmaker Kwon Seong-dong. (강릉시 공무원 출신으로 공무원노동조합 활동 중 해직과 복직 경험이 있는 김 당선인은 2012년 전국공무원노조 위원장에 선출돼 노동 운동을 이어갔다. 2024년 제22대 총선 강릉시 선거구에 민주당 소속으로 출마했으나 당시 권성동 국민의힘 의원에 밀려 낙선했다.)

In this Gangneung mayoral election, candidate Kim's son drew attention by joining the campaign. The son, a singer who debuted as a member of the idol group 'Big Star' in 2012 and now performs under the name Fromtwenty, posted photos and videos on Instagram of himself in blue clothing supporting his father's campaign. In response, some far-right netizens left comments containing profanity, such as "Who is the enemy of our country?", "No leftists," and "Destroy communism." (이번 강릉시장 선거에서는 김 당선인의 아들이 선거 운동에 나서며 화제가 됐다. 아들은 2012년 아이돌 그룹 ‘빅스타’로 데뷔한 뒤 지금은 프롬트웬티라는 이름으로 활동하고 있는 가수다. 그가 인스타그램에 파란색 옷을 입고 아버지 선거 운동을 하는 사진과 영상을 올리자 일부 극우 성향의 누리꾼들은 “우리나라 주적이 누구냐?”, “좌파는 안 된다”, “멸공” 등의 댓글과 함께 욕설을 적었다.)

As the victory became certain on the 4th, the elected candidate Kim shared his thoughts, saying, "The citizens are the residents, and in that journey to create hope, you all joined me and gave me the opportunity to work after 30 years. I will work harder to create hope for Gangneung." His son Fromtwenty stood by his side with a bright smile. (김 당선인은 4일 당선이 확실시되자 “시민이 주민이고 희망을 만드는 그 여정에 우리 시민 여러분이 함께해주시고 30년 만에 일할 수 있는 기회를 만들어주셨다”며 “더 열심히 해서 강릉의 희망을 만들겠다”고 소감을 밝혔다. 아들 프롬트웬티는 활짝 웃으며 그 옆을 지켰다.)

Song Kyung-hwa, Reporter freehwa@hani.co.kr (송경화 기자 freehwa@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Han Dong-hoon: "My Victory Is a Clear Warning Against the Lee Jae-myung Administration's 'Indictment Cancellation Spree'" (한동훈 “저의 승리는 이재명 정권 ‘공소취소 폭주’에 대한 명백한 경고”)
item.description:
After winning the hard-fought independent race in the Buk-gu district of Busan, the by-election winner Han Dong-hoon said on the 4th, "In Buk-gu, President Lee Jae-myung put forward his own proxy and intervened in various ways, but in the end, he lost to an independent, Han Dong-hoon." He added, "The public had been saying about the Lee Jae-myung Democratic Party administration that anything could be done before, but in this (election), they have given a meaningful warning." (‘무소속 혈투’ 끝에 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거에서 승리한 한동훈 당선자는 4일 “북구갑에서 이재명 대통령이 자기 대리인으로 내세우고 여러 방식으로 개입하고, 결국 무소속인 한동훈에게 패배했다”며 “국민들이 이재명 민주당 정권에 대해 마치 그 전에는 뭐든 해도 될 것처럼 얘기했지만, 이번 (선거에서) 의미 있는 경고를 해주셨다”고 말했다.)

At a press conference held at his election office, the winner-elect said to President Lee, "Throughout the election, I said we should ask the citizens how they judge such tricks as canceling indictments, and I warn you to accept that." He added, "I said my victory would be a clear warning against the Lee Jae-myung administration's spree of canceling indictments, and now I think we must play the role of blocking it (in the National Assembly)." ( 한 당선자는 이날 자신의 선거사무소에서 기자회견을 열고, 이 대통령을 향해 “선거 내내 공소취소 같은 협잡을 시민들이 어떻게 판단하시는지 물어보자고 얘기했는데, 그 점을 받아들이라고 경고한다”고 말했다. 그는 “저의 승리는 이재명 정권 공소취소 폭주에 대한 명백한 경고가 될 것이라고 했고, 이제 (국회에서 그것을) 저지하는 역할해야 할 것 같다”고 덧붙였다. )

Regarding this election, the winner-elect also said, "The people have not completely abandoned the conservative party, but they have given victory to those who sympathize with the direction of conservative rebuilding." He added, "I have had phone conversations with many lawmakers who had been distant, exchanging kind words, and many of them sympathize with the cause and principles of the conservative rebuilding direction I proposed." He further stated, "The words and actions of the current party power figures, who appear to represent the People Power Party, do not match the dignity or capability that the conservative party has brought. I think it is time for them to reflect and properly set the direction." <<> Reporter Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr ( 한 당선자는 또, 이번 선거에 대해 “국민들께서 보수 정당을 완전히 버리시지도 않으면서도 보수 재건 방향성에 공감하는 분들에게 승리를 안겨주신 것”이라며 “그동안 소원했던 많은 의원님들과 덕담 나누며 통화했는데, 제가 제시했던 보수 재건 방향에 대한 명분과 대의에 공감하는 분들이 굉장히 많다”고 했다. 이어 “지금 마치 국민의힘을 대표하는 것처럼 보이는 당권파들의 언행은 보수 정당이 가져온 품격이나 실력에 맞지 않다. 이제는 좀 반성하고 방향을 제대로 잡아야 한다고 생각”고 덧붙였다. )

item.title: 13-Hour Chase: Oh Se-hoon’s First Comeback at 7:16 AM – A Tense All-Night Vote Count Battle (13시간 추격 오세훈, 아침 7시16분 첫 역전…피 말린 밤샘 개표전)
item.description:
In the 6·3 local elections for metropolitan mayors across 16 districts, Seoul was undeniably the final battleground. From the evening of the 3rd, when exit poll results were announced, until the early hours of the 4th, well into the mid-stages of the vote count, Oh Se-hoon of the People Power Party, who had been steadily chasing Jeong Won-oh of the Democratic Party of Korea, gradually narrowed the gap and achieved his first comeback just past 7:00 AM. Oh, who had kept a low profile throughout the night, appeared at his election campaign office around 10:00 AM with a margin of about 30,000 votes, able to deliver his victory speech with a bright expression. Oh later remarked, “There were moments that were mentally tough, but by around 5:00 AM, I was confident of victory.” (6·3 지방선거 광역단체장 선거 16곳 중 최후의 접전지는 단연 서울이었다. 출구조사 결과가 발표된 3일 저녁부터 개표 중반을 넘어선 4일 새벽까지 줄곧 정원오 더불어민주당 후보를 추격하던 오세훈 국민의힘 후보는 조금씩 격차를 좁혀 오전 7시가 넘은 시점 처음 역전에 성공했다. 밤새 모습을 드러내지 않던 오 후보는 3만여표 차이로 격차를 벌린 오전 10시께 선거사무소에 등장해 밝은 표정으로 당선 인사를 할 수 있었다. 오 후보도 “마음이 힘들어진 순간도 있었지만 새벽 5시경에는 승리를 확신할 수 있었다”고 말했다.)

The exit poll predictions from three major broadcasters (KBS, MBC, SBS), released right after polls closed, showed Jeong at 51.4% and Oh at 46.0%. A JTBC forecast indicated Oh trailing by 10.6 percentage points. At Oh’s campaign office in Jongno-gu, Seoul, staff members were left speechless as they watched the exit polls. Soft sighs of disappointment and hollow smiles of disbelief crossed the room. In contrast, cheers erupted from Jeong’s camp. Early in the vote count, when advance ballots were first opened, Jeong briefly led Oh by more than 30 percentage points. (투표 마감 직후 발표된 방송 3사(KBS·MBC·SBS) 출구조사 예상득표율은 정 후보 51.4%, 오 후보 46%였다. 제이티비시(JTBC) 예측조사에선 오 후보가 10.6%포인트 뒤지는 것으로 나왔다. 서울 종로구 선거사무소에 나와있던 오 후보 캠프 관계자들은 출구조사를 보며 말을 잇지 못했다. 캠프 곳곳에서 ‘허’ 하는 얕은 한숨과 믿기지 않는다는 듯한 허탈한 미소가 교차했다. 반면 정 후보 캠프에서는 환호성이 터져나왔다. 사전투표함이 먼저 열린 개표 초반 한때 정 후보가 오 후보를 30%포인트 이상 앞서기도 했다.)

Throughout the night, Oh’s camp had been subdued, but as dawn approached, a sense of anticipation grew. By 4:30 AM, the vote gap had narrowed to below 100,000, and by around 6:00 AM, it was about 20,000 votes. Votes for Oh poured in from Songpa-gu, where ballot shortages had delayed counting, and from Dongjak-gu, part of the ‘Han River Belt.’ At 7:05 AM, as the gap shrank to 0.1 percentage points, party officials one by one rose from their seats. At 7:16 AM, when Oh succeeded in overtaking Jeong, chants of “Oh Se-hoon” rang out, and by after 9:00 AM, with the gap widening to about 30,000 votes, shouts of “We won!” were heard. (밤새 침체돼있던 오 후보 캠프에는 아침이 밝아오면서 기대감이 감돌았다. 새벽 4시30분을 지나 10만표 아래로 좁혀진 두 후보의 표차는 오전 6시께 2만여표가 됐다. 전날 투표용지 부족 사태로 개표가 늦어진 송파구, ‘한강벨트’ 동작구 등에서 오 후보 표가 쏟아져 나왔다. 오전 7시5분 0.1%포인트까지 좁혀진 격차에 당 관계자들이 하나둘 자리에서 일어섰다. 오전 7시16분 오 후보가 역전에 성공하자 “오세훈”을 연호하는 소리가, 오전 9시 넘어 두 후보의 격차가 3만여표로 벌어지자 “이겼다”는 함성이 나왔다.)

At exactly 10:00 AM, Oh, having finished the nail-biting contest, appeared at his campaign office to a warm ovation. Reflecting on the experience, Oh said, “From the very start of the election campaign, I never once doubted victory. But in my heart, I approached it with the mindset of a challenger.” (오전 10시 정각, 진땀승부를 끝낸 오 후보가 뜨거운 환호를 받으며 캠프에 등장했다. 오 후보는 “선거전 시작 때부터 단 한순간도 승리를 확신하지 않은 적이 없었다. 그러나 마음만큼은 도전자의 정신으로 임했다”고 소회를 밝혔다.)

Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr (유영재 기자 young@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Jo Kuk’s Fatal Injury from ‘Third-Place Defeat’... Momentum for Merger with Democratic Party Lost (‘3위 낙선’ 조국 치명상…민주당과 합당론 동력 잃었다)
item.description:
In the June 3 by-election, the Rebuilding Korea Party and its leader, Jo Kuk, suffered a critical blow. Despite pouring all the party’s resources into the Pyeongtaek-eul National Assembly by-election where Jo himself ran, he received a painful result of finishing in third place. In the elections for heads of basic local governments in the Honam region, the party also underperformed, winning only two seats. This has cast a dark cloud over the Rebuilding Korea Party’s initial plan to solidify its political foundation through discussions on a merger with the Democratic Party of Korea after Jo enters the National Assembly. <<> Jo bowed his head as he visited his campaign office on Jaungno, Pyeongtaek, around 2:47 AM on the 4th, after his defeat became certain. He said, “The top priority in this June election was to achieve ‘zero seats for the People Power Party.’ In Pyeongtaek, I failed to fulfill that order. This is all due to my inadequacy and my responsibility.” In the final vote count that day, Jo received only 27.2% of the vote, finishing in third place behind Democratic Party candidate Kim Yong-nam (28.8%), with whom he had been at odds throughout the campaign. Having called for “zero People Power Party,” he ultimately conceded his seat to People Power Party candidate Yoo Eui-dong (34.8%) in his own election. <<> The Rebuilding Korea Party’s performance in the local elections also fell short. The party, which aimed to expand its presence in the Honam region, managed to win only two seats for heads of basic local governments in South Jeolla Province (Sin-an County and Jangheung County) and lost the incumbent post of Damyang County head to the Democratic Party. The party had initially targeted victories in about five areas. <<> Discussions on a merger with the Democratic Party have also lost their way, as Jo’s defeat has undermined the very axis of such negotiations. The two parties had already deepened their emotional rift during the election process through mutual slander between Jo and Kim, as well as the dispute over who was the “true Democratic Party candidate.” The future of the 12 proportional representation lawmakers of the Rebuilding Korea Party, who had hoped to boost their presence through a merger with the Democratic Party before the 2028 general election, has also grown dim. <<> Reporter Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr (이번 6·3 선거에서 조국혁신당과 조국 대표는 치명타를 입었다. 조 대표가 나선 경기 평택을 국회의원 재선거에 당력을 모두 쏟아부었음에도 3등이라는 뼈아픈 성적표를 받았다. 호남 기초자치단체장 선거에서도 기대 이하(2곳)의 성과를 거뒀다. 조 대표가 국회에 입성한 뒤 더불어민주당과의 합당 논의를 발판으로 정치적 기반을 확고히 하려던 혁신당의 애초 구상에도 먹구름이 끼게 됐다.)

item.title: Kim Bu-gyeom’s ‘Daegu Change Theory’ Falls Short of Last-Minute Conservative Consolidation… Park Geun-hye Also Plays a Role (김부겸 ‘대구 변화론’ 막판 보수 결집엔 역부족…박근혜도 한몫)
item.description:
Analysis suggests that Kim Bu-gyeom, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate in the June 3 Daegu mayoral election, faltered despite early momentum because he could not overcome the wall of conservative consolidation formed in the final stages of the race. The controversy over the ruling party’s push for a special counsel law targeting alleged manipulated prosecutions and former President Park Geun-hye’s campaign support are said to have fueled conservative voters’ desire to check the current administration. (6·3 대구시장 선거에 출마한 김부겸 더불어민주당 후보가 초반 선전에도 불구하고 석패한 이유는 선거 막판 형성된 보수 결집의 벽을 넘지 못했기 때문이라는 분석이 나온다. 여당의 조작기소 특검법 추진 논란과 박근혜 전 대통령의 지원 유세 등이 보수층의 정권 견제론을 자극했다는 것이다.)

In the Daegu mayoral election, where vote counting was completed on the 4th, People Power Party candidate Choo Kyung-ho secured 702,421 votes (53.9%), defeating Kim, who garnered 586,927 votes (45.1%), by a margin of 115,494 votes (8.8 percentage points). Kim’s vote share is the highest for a Democratic Party-affiliated candidate since the first local elections in 1995. Compared to Kim’s performance in the 2014 Daegu mayoral election as the candidate of the New Politics Alliance for Democracy (now the Democratic Party), where he received 40.3%, this election’s vote share is 4.8 percentage points higher. (4일 개표가 완료된 대구시장 선거에서 추경호 국민의힘 후보는 70만2421표(53.9%)를 득표해, 58만6927표(45.1%)를 얻은 김 후보를 11만5494표(8.8%포인트) 차이로 앞서며 당선됐다. 김 후보의 득표율은 1995년 1회 지방선거가 시작된 이래 민주당 계열 후보로서는 최고치다. 2014년 김 후보가 새정치민주연합(현 민주당) 후보로 대구시장 선거에 도전했을 때 얻은 득표율(40.3%)에 견줘도 이번 선거 득표율이 4.8%포인트 높다.)

The Daegu mayoral race initially favored Kim, but it turned into a tight contest as a series of ruling party-related variables emerged, including the Democratic Party’s push for a special counsel law on manipulated prosecutions (introduced on April 30) and the government and ruling party’s boycott movement following the Starbucks ‘May 18 Tank Day marketing’ controversy (on the 18th of last month). (대구시장 선거전은 김 후보가 초반 우세를 점했지만, ‘민주당이 추진한 조작기소 특검법 발의(4월30일)’와 ‘스타벅스 ‘5·18 탱크데이 마케팅’ 논란에 따른 정부·여당의 불매 움직임(지난달 18일) 등 여권발 변수들이 잇따라 불거지며 접전 양상으로 흘러갔다.)

In response, Kim emphasized his ‘1-hit-3-birds theory’—that voting for him would check the Democratic Party, foster healthy conservatism, and revive Daegu’s economy—courting the city’s voters. Regarding the special counsel law aimed at potentially nullifying President Yoon’s indictment, Kim appealed to his party, saying, “If you don’t intend to abandon the comrades struggling out here, proceed cautiously” (on the 3rd of last month). On the Starbucks boycott, he stated, “The government or political circles should not publicly pressure specific companies or create an atmosphere criticizing consumption itself” (on the 26th of last month), but these efforts were insufficient to reverse public opinion rallying behind Choo. (이에 김 후보가 자신을 찍으면 ‘민주당을 견제하고 건강한 보수를 만들고 대구 경제도 살릴 수 있다는 ‘1타3피론’’을 강조하며 대구 표심에 구애를 보냈다. 이 대통령의 공소취소 가능성을 열어둔 조작기소 특검법 추진에 김 후보는 당을 향해 “여기서 고생하면서 뛰고 있는 동지들을 버릴 셈이 아니라면 신중히 해 달라”(지난달 3일)고 호소하고, 스타벅스 불매 흐름에는 “정부나 정치권이 특정 기업을 공개적으로 압박하거나 소비 자체를 비난하는 분위기로 흐르면 안 된다”(지난달 26일)고 했지만 추 후보로 결집하는 여론을 되돌리기에 역부족이었다.)

Former President Park’s appearances to support Choo’s campaign on the 23rd and 31st of last month are also seen as providing justification for conservative consolidation. A source from Kim’s campaign said, “Despite dissatisfaction with the People Power Party leadership, Park’s involvement seems to have had the effect of bringing to the polls existing conservative voters who, saying ‘I can’t vote for Kim Bu-gyeom,’ were considering abstaining.” (박 전 대통령이 지난달 23일과 31일 추 후보 지원 유세에 나선 것도 보수 결집의 명분을 줬다는 평가가 나온다. 김 후보 캠프 관계자는 “장동혁 국민의힘 지도부에 대한 불만에도 ‘김부겸은 못 찍겠다’며 투표를 포기하려던 기존 보수층을 투표장으로 나오게 하는 효과는 있었던 것으로 보인다”고 했다.)

The Daegu region recorded its highest voter turnout (64.2%) in this local election, exceeding the national average of 61%. Professor Um Ki-hong of Kyungpook National University (Department of Political Science and Diplomacy) commented, “Supporters of both candidates were mobilized to the polls at peak levels, and some centrist sentiment appears to have shifted to Choo as well.” (대구 지역은 이번에 역대 지방선거 중 최고 투표율(64.2%)을 나타냈다. 전국 평균 투표율(61%)보다 높은 수치다. 엄기홍 경북대 교수(정치외교학과)는 “두 후보 지지층이 각각 최고조로 결집해 다 투표장으로 나온 데다 중도층 민심 일부도 추 후보에게 간 것 같다”고 했다.)

Go Han-sol Reporter sol@hani.co.kr (고한솔 기자 sol@hani.co.kr)

item.title: [Breaking] Cho Kuk Resigns as Leader of the Innovation Party… "I Will Take Responsibility for Election Defeat" ([속보] 조국, 혁신당 대표직 사퇴…“선거 패배 책임지겠다”)
item.description:
Cho Kuk, leader of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party, abruptly resigned on the 4th, stating, "I will take responsibility for the defeat in the June 3 election." (조국 조국혁신당 대표가 “6·3 선거 패배의 책임을 지겠다”며 4일 전격 사퇴했다.)

In a post on his Facebook page that day, Cho said, "In this election, I failed to open a new path of hope for the fellow party members who devoted themselves under the name of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party. It is all due to my shortcomings." He stepped down from the leadership, adding, "I will pause for a moment, but I urge my fellow party members to move forward with confidence." (조 대표는 이날 자신의 페이스북에 글을 올려 “이번 선거에서 조국혁신당의 이름으로 헌신한 당원 동지들 앞에 새로운 희망의 길을 열지 못했다. 모두 제가 부족했던 탓”이며 “저는 잠시 멈추지만, 당원 동지들은 당당하게 직진해 달라”며 대표직에서 물러났다.)

He stated, "Although the results of the June 3 election are expected to lead to internal debates and rifts within the pan-democratic camp, the fact remains that the Cho Kuk Innovation Party is the third-largest party in the National Assembly with 12 seats, representing progressive reform." He urged party members to "bring a definitive end to the era-defining task of prosecutorial reform." He continued, "There is no rule that losing one battle means giving up the war," and added, "I will reflect on myself, temper myself, and prepare for what comes next." (그는 “6·3 선거의 결과로 인해 범민주진영 내부 논쟁과 균열이 예상되지만, 조국혁신당이 열두 석을 가진 진보개혁적 원내 3당이라는 사실은 변치 않는다”며 “시대적 과제인 검찰개혁에 확실한 마침표를 찍어달라”고 당원들에게 당부했다. 이어 “한 번의 전투에서 졌다고 전쟁을 포기하는 법은 없다”며 “저 자신을 성찰하고 담금질하면서 다음을 준비하겠다”고 말했다.)

Reported by Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr and Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr (이지은 기자 jieuny@hani.co.kr 김채운 기자 cwk@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Presidential Office to Announce New Prime Minister Around 5th Amid Shock of 'Seoul Defeat' and Reform Appointments (청와대, ‘서울 패배’ 충격 속 쇄신 인사…5일께 신임 총리 발표)
item.description:
On the 4th, the day after the June 3 local elections, the atmosphere at the Presidential Office was heavy. Although the ruling party won 12 out of 16 elections for heads of metropolitan and provincial governments, the shock of the Seoul mayoral election defeat reported that morning was considerable. President Lee is expected to begin announcing a successor to Prime Minister Kim Min-seok as early as the 5th, followed by a cabinet reshuffle and reorganization of the presidential staff. (6·3 지방선거 이튿날인 4일, 청와대 분위기는 무겁게 가라 앉았다. 16곳의 광역단체장 선거 중 12곳에서 여당이 승리했지만 이날 아침 전해진 서울시장 선거 패배 충격이 적지 않은 탓이었다. 이 대통령은 이르면 5일께 김민석 국무총리 후임 발표를 시작으로 개각과 청와대 참모진 개편에 나설 예정이다.)

President Lee Jae-myung said at a meeting of senior presidential secretaries that day, "We humbly accept the people's will and will actively cooperate with local governments regardless of their party affiliation." Senior Presidential Press Secretary Kang Yu-jeong told reporters, "All elections are an opportunity to confirm the diverse voices of the people," adding, "We will heed the public sentiment and use it as a chance for stabilizing people's livelihoods and national unity." (이재명 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 한 수석보좌관 회의에서 “국민 뜻 겸허하게 받들어 소속 정당 여부 관계없이 지방정부와 적극 협력 하겠다”고 말했다. 강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 기자들에게 “모든 선거는 국민의 다양한 목소리를 확인할 수 있는 계기”라며 “민심을 잘 받들어 민생 안정 국민통합 계기로 삼아 나가겠다”고 말했다.)

Inside the Presidential Office, the loss in the Seoul mayoral election was described as heartbreaking. A presidential official said, "Seoul is the most important, but we couldn't overcome the real estate wall of the four Gangnam districts." Particularly, as the Lee Jae-myung administration marks its first anniversary, facing a check on public opinion in Seoul has led to a mood of taking the results seriously. The fact that President-elect Oh Se-hoon strongly criticized the government's real estate policies during the election campaign and has vowed to voice opposition in cabinet meetings is also an uncomfortable point. (청와대 내부에서는 서울시장 선거 패배는 뼈아프다는 말이 나왔다. 한 청와대 관계자는 “서울이 제일 중요한데, 강남 4구의 부동산 벽을 넘지 못했다”고 말했다. 특히 이재명 정부 출범 1주년에 서울에서 견제 여론을 마주한 터라 결과를 무겁게 받아들이는 분위기다. 오세훈 당선자가 선거전에서 정부의 부동산 대책을 강도높게 비판하며 국무회의에서 반대 목소리를 내겠다고 해온 점도 불편한 대목이다.)

President Lee is expected to pursue a mood overhaul through a cabinet reshuffle and presidential office reorganization. President Lee is scheduled to announce on the 5th the successor to Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, who is running in the Democratic Party's national convention in August. For the successor to Prime Minister Kim, three candidates have been shortlisted: Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik, Minister of Justice Jung Sung-ho, and Minister of SMEs and Startups Han Sung-sook. Chief Kang is evaluated as highly trusted by President Lee and suitable for continuity of work, having been involved in state affairs for over a year. Minister Jung Sung-ho, as the 'leader of the pro-Lee faction,' has also worked closely with President Lee for a long time. Minister Han Sung-sook, a former CEO of Naver, if nominated as prime minister, would become the first female prime minister of the Lee Jae-myung administration and the first since former Prime Minister Han Myeong-sook, carrying symbolic significance. (이 대통령은 개각과 청와대 개편을 통해 분위기 쇄신에 나설 것으로 보인다. 이 대통령은 오는 8월 민주당 전당대회에 출마하는 김민석 국무총리 후임 인사를 5일께 발표할 예정이다. 김 총리는 후임으로는 강훈식 비서실장, 정성호 법무부 장관, 한성숙 중소벤처기업부 장관 등 3명이 압축된 상태다. 강 실장은 이 대통령의 신뢰가 두텁고, 1년 넘게 국정에 함께해온 만큼 업무 연속성에서 적격이라는 평가다. 정성호 장관도 ‘친명계 좌장’으로 이 대통령과 오래 호흡을 맞춰왔다. 네이버 대표이사 출신인 한성숙 장관은 총리에 지명되면 이재명 정부의 첫 여성 총리이자 한명숙 전 총리 이후 첫 여성 총리라는 상징성을 띠게 된다.)

Whoever among them is nominated as prime minister, it is expected to naturally lead to a chain of presidential staff reorganization and cabinet reshuffle. (이들 가운데 누가 총리에 지명되더라도 자연스레 청와대 참모진 개편과 내각 개편이 연쇄적으로 이뤄질 전망이다.)

The Presidential Office is already accelerating its internal reorganization work. Verification of successors for some senior secretaries, including Senior Presidential Secretary for Civil Affairs Bong Wook and Senior Presidential Secretary for Public Relations and Communication Lee Kyu-yeon, is underway. Although a cabinet reshuffle is also expected soon, the scope of changes is not likely to be large. Among those around the Presidential Office, there are many predictions that about three to four ministers will be replaced. (이미 청와대는 내부 개편 작업도 속도를 내고 있다. 봉욱 민정수석과 이규연 홍보소통수석 등 일부 수석들은 후임 검증 작업이 진행중이다. 개각도 곧 이뤄질 전망이지만, 교체 폭은 크지 않을 것으로 보인다. 청와대 주변에서는 3∼4개 부처 장관 정도가 교체될 것이라는 전망이 많다.)

item.title: What about the smaller parties within the two major parties?…Progressive Party 41, Reform Party 1, Justice Party 6 (거대 양당 속 소수정당 성적은?…진보당 41명, 개혁신당 1명, 정의당 6명)
item.description:
In the June 3 local elections, besides the Democratic Party of Korea and the People Power Party, minor parties such as the Progressive Party, Reform Party, Justice Party, and Green Party also fielded various candidates ranging from metropolitan mayors to district council members, competing fiercely. (6·3 지방선거에서는 더불어민주당이나 국민의힘 말고도 진보당과 개혁신당, 정의당, 녹색당 등 소수 정당도 광역단체장에서 기초의원에 이르기까지 다양한 후보들을 내며 치열하게 선거에 임했다.)

The party with the most notable performance was the Progressive Party. The Progressive Party elected a total of 41 candidates in the local elections, achieving nearly double the results from four years ago (21). The Progressive Party lost the by-election for the National Assembly in Pyeongtaek-eul, Gyeonggi Province, where co-leader Kim Jae-yeon ran. However, it elected 7 metropolitan council members and 34 district council members. Senior spokesperson Son Sol said on the 4th, "This is a valuable achievement, double that of the local elections four years ago. In particular, we produced 29 winners in the Honam region, beginning to establish ourselves as an alternative party, and in Seoul, we had 5 district council winners, opening up the possibility of progressive politics in the capital area as well." The Progressive Party also produced winners in the Yeongnam region, where progressive support is weak, including 1 metropolitan council member (Ulsan) and 4 district council members (2 in Busan, 1 in Ulsan, 1 in South Gyeongsang). (가장 도드라진 성과를 낸 정당은 진보당이다. 진보당은 지방선거에서 모두 41명을 당선시키며 4년 전(21명)의 2배에 가까운 성과를 거뒀다. 진보당은 김재연 상임대표가 출마한 경기 평택을 국회의원 재선거에서는 패했다. 그러나 광역의원 7명과 기초의원 34명을 당선시켰다. 손솔 진보당 수석대변인은 4일 “4년 전 지방선거에 비해 두 배로 늘어난 값진 성과다. 특히 호남에서 29명의 당선자를 배출하며 대안 정당으로 자리매김하기 시작했고, 서울에서 (구의원) 5명의 당선자를 내며 수도권에서도 진보 정치의 가능성을 열었다”고 말했다. 진보당은 진보 지지세가 약한 영남에서도 광역의원 1명(울산)과 기초의원 4명(부산 2명, 울산 1명, 경남 1명)의 당선자를 냈다.)

The Reform Party received results that fell short of expectations. (개혁신당은 기대에 못 미치는 성적을 받았다.)

In its first local elections since its founding, the Reform Party fielded 190 candidates. However, only one district council member (Kim Ki-hyun, Hwaseong City Council, Gyeonggi Province) was elected. Candidate Kim Jeong-cheol, who ran for Seoul mayor, garnered 0.82% of the vote. Leader Lee Jun-seok held a closing ceremony for the central election committee on the same day, bowing his head and saying, "We received results that did not meet the public's expectations." Other parliamentary parties, such as the Basic Income Party and the Social Democratic Party, produced no elected candidates. (개혁신당은 창당 뒤 처음 치른 지방선거에서 190명의 후보를 냈다. 그러나 기초의원 1명(김기현 경기 화성시의원)만 당선되는 데 그쳤다. 서울시장 선거에 나선 김정철 후보는 0.82%를 득표했다. 이준석 대표는 이날 중앙선거대책위원회 해단식을 열고 “국민의 기대에 미치지 못하는 결과를 받았다”며 고개를 숙였다. 또다른 원내 정당인 기본소득당과 사회민주당은 당선자를 내지 못했다.)

In the Justice Party, leader Kwon Young-kook lost in the Seoul mayoral election. However, the party elected a total of 6 district council members nationwide. The Justice Party stated on the same day, "We acknowledge that this outcome falls short of expectations," adding, "Of the 9 incumbent local council members, 8 ran and 5 were re-elected. We assess that the activities of Justice Party local council members in their regions were recognized by the residents." The Green Party produced its first local council member since its founding. Heo Seung-gyu, a Green Party candidate for the Andong City Council in North Gyeongsang Province, won first place in the Andong-si District 5 constituency with 36.9% of the vote. (정의당은 서울시장 선거에 나선 권영국 대표가 낙선했다. 그러나 전국에서 모두 6명의 기초의원 당선자를 냈다. 정의당은 이날 “기대에 미치지 못하는 결과임을 인정한다”면서도 “현역 지방의원 9명 중 8명이 출마해 그중 5명이 재선됐다. 정의당 지방의원들이 지역에서 보여준 활동이 주민들께 인정받은 결과라고 평가한다”고 말했다. 녹색당은 창당 이래 첫 지방의원을 배출했다. 허승규 녹색당 경북 안동시의원 당선자는 안동시 마선거구에서 36.9%를 얻어 1위로 당선됐다.)

Reporter Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr Reporter Jang Na-rae wing@hani.co.kr (김채운 기자 cwk@hani.co.kr 장나래 기자 wing@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Ultimately, It's About Election Denial and "Yoon Again"... The Transformation of Third-Place Candidate Kim Hyun-tae (결국 속내는 선거불복·윤 어게인…‘3위’ 김현태의 변)
item.description:
Kim Hyun-tae, an independent candidate who lost by over 34,000 votes in the Incheon Gyeyang-eul by-election for the National Assembly, held alongside the June 3 local elections, has claimed the election was invalid, arguing, "It makes no sense unless it was a fraudulent election." This appears to be a move to spread conspiracy theories about election fraud, using the shortage of ballot papers as a pretext, and to rationalize the December 3 insurrection. (6·3 지방선거와 함께 치러진 인천 계양을 국회의원 보궐선거에서 1위와 3만4천여표 차이로 낙선한 김현태 무소속 후보가 “부정선거가 아니고는 말이 안 된다”며 선거 무효를 주장했다. 투표용지 부족 사태를 빌미 삼아 부정선거 음모론을 확산하고 12·3 내란을 합리화하려는 움직임으로 보인다.)

On the early morning of the 4th, Candidate Kim posted a video on his YouTube channel, saying, "Ridiculous results from early voting are coming in. As of this hour, I officially declare a halt to the vote counting and the election invalid." (김 후보는 4일 새벽 자신의 유튜브 채널에 영상을 올려 “말도 안 되는 사전투표 (개표) 결과가 나오고 있다. 이 시간부로 공식적으로 개표 중단과 선거 무효를 선언하겠다”고 말했다.)

Candidate Kim, who served as the commander of the 707th Special Missions Group of the Army Special Warfare Command during the December 3 insurrection, is on trial for charges of leading troops to infiltrate the main building of the National Assembly (engaging in critical duties for an insurrection). Amid this, he ran in Incheon Gyeyang-eul, the former district of President Lee Jae-myung, stating, "I will bring down the Lee Jae-myung regime." Late in the campaign, it was revealed that Candidate Kim's registered address was in the Gyeyang-gap district, meaning he could not even vote in Gyeyang-eul. On the 3rd, he appeared as an observer at the Incheon Gyeyang Gymnasium, where vote counting was underway. (12·3 내란 당시 육군 특수전사령부 707특수임무단장이었던 김 후보는 병력을 이끌고 국회 본관에 침투한 혐의(내란 중요임무 종사)로 재판을 받는 와중에 “이재명 정권을 무너뜨리겠다”며 이재명 대통령의 옛 지역구인 인천 계양을에 출마했다. 선거 막판 김 후보의 주소지가 계양갑 선거구라 정작 계양을에서는 투표권을 행사하지 못하는 것으로 나타났는데, 김 후보는 3일 개표 작업이 진행된 인천 계양체육관에 참관인 자격으로 모습을 드러냈다.)

Candidate Kim claimed to have personally witnessed evidence of election fraud. He argued, "So far, (the early voting results) show that (Democratic Party candidate) Kim Nam-jun had over 75%, while I had about 4%. That's really nonsensical." (김 후보는 부정선거의 증거를 본인 눈으로 직접 봤다고 주장했다. 김 후보는 “지금까지 사전투표 (개표 결과가) 공개된 게 (더불어민주당 후보) 김남준이 75% 넘었다는 이야기가 있고 나는 4%대라고 하는데 정말 말이 안 된다”고 주장했다.)

He added, "I was at the on-site voting (counting) for a bit and confirmed with my own eyes that my votes were around 20%. If on-site voting, which is hard to manipulate, shows around 20%, how much would early voting have to be rigged to drop it to 4%?" He then asserted, "Unless it was a fraudulent election, it doesn't make sense." (그는 “내가 본투표 (개표) 현장에 좀 있다 왔는데 내 눈으로 본 것은 내 표가 20% 내외라고 확인했다”며 “조작이 어려운 본투표에서는 (20% 내외인데) 사전투표를 얼마나 조작했으면 4%대로 떨어지냐”고도 했다. 그러면서 “부정선거가 아니고는 말이 되지 않는다”고 주장했다.)

According to the vote count results, Candidate Kim received 9,248 votes (13.01%), placing third. Candidate Kim Nam-jun won with 43,822 votes (61.65%), and People Power Party candidate Shim Wang-seop received 18,005 votes (25.33%). (개표 결과 김 후보는 9248표(13.01%)를 얻어 3위를 기록했다. 김남준 후보가 43822표(61.65%)를 얻어 당선됐고, 심왕섭 국민의힘 후보는 18005표(25.33%)를 얻었다.)

Even though the first-place candidate, Kim Nam-jun, received nearly five times as many votes as Candidate Kim, Kim Hyun-tae refused to back down from his claims of election fraud, asserting, "Fake ballot papers are being found nationwide, including in our election district." (1위인 김남준 후보가 김 후보에 견줘 5배가량 많은 득표수를 기록했음에도 김 후보는 부정선거 주장을 굽히지 않으며 “전국적으로, 우리 선거 지역에서도 가짜 투표용지가 발견되고 있다”고 주장했다.)

Candidate Kim continued similar claims at a protest rally over the "ballot paper shortage incident" held in front of the National Election Commission in Gwacheon, Gyeonggi Province, early that morning. He also shouted "Yoon Again." Before running for the National Assembly, Candidate Kim claimed to have received approval from former President Yoon Suk-yeol, saying, "I got approval to shout 'I am Yoon Suk-yeol.'" He then chanted "Yoon Again," and participants at the rally responded by shouting "Yoon Again" in support. (김 후보는 이날 새벽 경기 과천 중앙선거관리위원회 앞에서 열린 ‘투표용지 부족 사태’ 항의 집회에서도 비슷한 주장을 이어갔다. ‘윤 어게인’도 외쳤다. 김 후보는 국회의원 출마 전 윤석열 전 대통령에게 “‘내가 윤석열이다’라고 외쳐도 좋다는 승인을 받았다”고 주장하며 “윤 어게인”을 외쳤고, 집회 참가자들은 “윤 어게인”을 외치며 호응했다.)

Remarks defending the December 3 insurrection were also included. Candidate Kim made statements such as, "President Yoon Suk-yeol's martial law was legal," "Why did President Yoon Suk-yeol declare martial law? Because of election fraud," and "President Yoon Suk-yeol risked his life to root out anti-state forces." (12·3 내란 옹호 발언도 빠지지 않았다. 김 후보는 “윤석열 대통령의 비상계엄은 합법적”, “윤석열 대통령이 왜 비상계엄을 선포했나. 부정선거 때문이다”, “윤석열 대통령은 목숨을 걸고 반국가 세력을 척결하려고 했다” 등의 발언을 쏟아냈다.)

Reporter Jeon Gwang-joon light@hani.co.kr (전광준 기자 light@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Chung Dong-young Mentions "Democratic People's Republic of Korea" at International Event, Proposes Four-Party Talks for Peace Regime (정동영, 국제 행사서 “조선인민공화국” 언급…평화체제 4자 대화 제안)
item.description:
Unification Minister Chung Dong-young said on the 4th, "We can initiate four-party talks involving the Republic of Korea (ROK), the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), the United States, and China." (정동영 통일부 장관이 4일 “우리는 대한민국(ROK), 조선민주주의인민공화국(DPRK), 미국과 중국 간 4자 대화를 시작할 수 있다”고 말했다.)

Minister Chung made this statement during a special address at the 11th Ulaanbaatar Northeast Asian Security Dialogue held in Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia. This marks the first time Minister Chung has used North Korea's official state name at an international event. (정 장관은 이날 몽골 울란바토르에서 열린 제11차 울란바토르 동북아 안보대화 특별연설에서 이렇게 말했다. 정 장관이 국제 행사에서 북한의 국호를 부른 건 처음이다.)

He proposed the four-party talks as part of efforts to establish a peace regime on the Korean Peninsula, a key initiative of the Lee Jae-myung administration. "We should expand this (four-party) framework to include other Northeast Asian countries such as Mongolia, Japan, and Russia," he said. "If we rebuild trust between the two Koreas, institutionalize a 'peace regime on the Korean Peninsula,' and advance multilateral dialogue in Northeast Asia—these three axes moving forward simultaneously—we can establish a new peace order across the entire region." (그는 이재명 정부가 추진하는 한반도 평화체제를 구축하는 차원에서 4자 대화를 제안했다. 그는 “(4자 대화) 틀을 확대해 몽골, 일본, 러시아를 포함한 다른 동북아시아 국가들도 함께하도록 해야 할 것”이라며 “남북 간 신뢰를 다시 쌓고, ‘한반도 평화체제’를 제도화하며, 동북아의 다자 대화를 진전시키는 것, 이 세 가지 축이 일제히 앞으로 나아간다면 동북아 전역에 새로운 평화 질서를 구축할 수 있다”고 말했다.)

Minister Chung suggested concrete plans to implement this vision, including cooperation on the Arctic shipping route linked to the Greater Tumen Initiative (GTI) and the connection of the Seoul-Beijing high-speed railway. "If GTI member countries work together, we can link regional railway networks—such as the Trans-Siberian Railway, Trans-China Railway, Trans-Mongolia Railway, and Seoul-Beijing High-Speed Railway—with the Arctic shipping route," he said. "To turn this vision into reality, I urge the Democratic People's Republic of Korea to rejoin the GTI as a full member." The Greater Tumen Initiative is a cooperation framework among Northeast Asian countries that originated from the Tumen River Area Development Programme led by the United Nations Development Programme in 1991. North Korea participated as a member when the initiative was launched in 2005 but withdrew in 2009, citing dissatisfaction with sanctions imposed on it. Minister Chung emphasized to North Korea, "The success of this initiative depends on the Democratic People's Republic of Korea's re-engagement, and they will be the greatest beneficiaries of this plan." (정 장관은 이를 구체화할 계획으로 광역두만개발계획(GTI)과 연계한 북극 항로 협력 및 서울-베이징 고속철도 연결을 제안했다. 정 장관은 “지티아이(GTI) 회원국들이 함께 노력한다면 우리는 시베리아 횡단철도, 중국 횡단철도, 몽골 횡단철도, 서울-베이징 고속철도와 같은 지역 철도망을 북극 항로와 연결할 수 있을 것”이라며 “이 구상을 현실로 바꾸기 위해, 조선민주주의인민공화국이 정회원으로 지티아이에 재가입할 것을 촉구한다”고 말했다. 광역두만개발계획은 1991년 유엔개발계획이 주도한 두만강지역개발계획에서 나온 동북아 국가들 간의 협력 구상이다. 북한은 2005년 이 계획 출범 당시 회원국으로 참여했지만, 2009년 대북제재에 대한 불만 등을 이유로 탈퇴했다. 정 장관은 북한을 향해 “이 구상의 성공은 조선민주주의인민공화국의 재참여에 달려 있으며, 그들은 이 구상의 가장 큰 수혜자가 될 것”이라고 강조했다.)

Earlier, Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin also mentioned the Greater Tumen Initiative during their summit last month. In a joint statement, they expressed their willingness to continue cooperation on this project with North Korea. President Lee Jae-myung also referenced the GTI during the South Korea-China summit in January, asking President Xi for China's cooperation and mediation. (앞서, 시진핑 중국 국가주석과 블라디미르 푸틴 러시아 대통령도 지난달 정상회담에서 광역두만개발계획을 언급했다. 이들은 공동성명에서 북한과 함께 이 사업 관련 협력을 지속한다는 의지를 표명했다. 이재명 대통령 또한 지난 1월 한-중 정상회담에서 광역두만개발계획을 언급하며 시 주석에게 중국의 협력과 중재를 요청한 바 있다.)

Minister Chung's use of North Korea's official state name in this address is also significant. At official domestic events, Minister Chung has previously referred to North Korea by its official name as part of his efforts to send a message of respect and trust-building toward North Korea. While introducing the Lee Jae-myung administration's policy of peaceful coexistence on the Korean Peninsula, he did not explicitly mention "two peaceful states" as an implementation strategy, but referring to North Korea by its official name can be seen as a recognition of its statehood. (이번 연설에서 정 장관이 북한을 공식 국호로 부른 것도 의미가 있다. 정 장관은 국내 공식 석상에서도 북한에 대한 존중과 신뢰 구축 메시지를 보낸다는 차원에서 국호로 칭한 바 있다. 이재명 정부의 한반도 평화공존 정책을 소개하면서 그 이행 전략으로 ‘평화적 두 국가’를 말하진 않았지만, 북한을 국호로 부르며 국가성을 인정한 차원도 있다.)

A Unification Ministry official earlier told reporters, "At international conferences, including at the United Nations, our government delegation has also referred to North Korea by its official name on multiple occasions." (통일부 당국자는 앞서 기자들과 만나 “유엔 무대를 포함한 국제회의에서 우리 정부대표단도 북한의 호칭을 공식 국호로 여러 차례 지칭했다”고 말했다.)

The Ulaanbaatar Dialogue in Mongolia is a representative multilateral consultative body in Northeast Asia, involving 20 to 30 countries and international organizations, including the United States, Japan, China, and Russia. Mongolia also operates diplomatic missions in both South and North Korea, maintaining friendly relations with both. However, North Korea has not participated in this dialogue since 2018. (몽골 울란바토르 대화는 미국과 일본, 중국, 러시아 등 20∼30개 국가와 국제기구가 참여하는 동북아시아의 대표적인 다자 협의체다. 몽골은 남한과 북한에 모두 공관을 운영하며 양자 모두와 우호적인 관계를 유지하는 나라기도 하다. 다만 북한은 2018년을 마지막으로 이 대화에 참여하지 않고 있다.)

Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: [News Analysis] Voters Rebuke People Power Party and Also Check the Ruling Party's Dominance ([뉴스분석] 국힘 꾸짖은 민심, 여당 독주도 견제했다)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung and the Democratic Party achieved a 'half-victory' in the June 3 simultaneous local elections and by-elections for the National Assembly. (6·3 전국동시지방선거 및 국회의원 재보궐선거에서 이재명 대통령과 더불어민주당이 ‘절반의 승리’를 거뒀다.)

The results for 16 metropolitan and provincial government heads were 12 for the Democratic Party and 4 for the People Power Party. Four years ago, out of 17, the People Power Party held 12 and the Democratic Party 5. The Democratic Party recaptured the mayoralties of Incheon, Busan, Ulsan, Daejeon, and Sejong, as well as the governorships of South Chungcheong and North Chungcheong. For the 25 district heads in Seoul, the Democratic Party took 17 and the People Power Party 8. Four years ago, the figures were reversed: 17 for the People Power Party and 8 for the Democratic Party. (16개 광역단체장 선거 결과는 민주당 12개, 국민의힘 4개였다. 4년 전에는 17개 중에서 국민의힘 12개, 민주당 5개였다. 민주당은 인천시장, 부산시장, 울산시장, 대전시장, 세종시장, 충남지사, 충북지사를 탈환했다. 서울 25개 구청장은 민주당이 17개, 국민의힘이 8개를 차지했다. 4년 전에는 국민의힘 17개, 민주당 8개였다. 정반대로 뒤집힌 것이다.)

The reasons for the Democratic Party's victory are largely analyzed in two ways. (민주당 승리의 원인은 크게 두 가지로 분석된다.)

First, President Lee Jae-myung's high approval rating. (첫째, 이재명 대통령의 높은 지지율이다.)

This election was held one year after President Lee Jae-myung's inauguration. This is an advantageous time for the ruling party. President Lee has maintained a stable job approval rating in the 60% range through his moderate, practical policy line and characteristic 'top-down' leadership. The stock market boom also bolstered the notion of stable state affairs. (이번 선거는 이재명 대통령 당선 1년 만에 치렀다. 집권 여당에 유리한 시기다. 이 대통령은 그동안 중도실용 정책 노선과 특유의 ‘만기친람’ 리더십으로 60%대의 안정적인 직무 평가를 유지했다. 주식시장 활황도 국정 안정론에 힘을 보탰다.)

Second, the logic of judging the opposition party, not the ruling party, was at play. The Democratic Party greatly benefited from the People Power Party's failure to reform. (둘째, 정권 심판론이 아니라 야당 심판론이 작동했다. 민주당은 이번 선거에서 국민의힘의 혁신 실패에 따른 반사이익을 한껏 누렸다.)

Since the December 3 emergency martial law, investigations and trials have continued concerning former President Yoon Suk-yeol and his wife, as well as those implicated in the December 3 insurrection. After last year's presidential election, numerous conservative commentators strongly demanded that the People Power Party sever ties with former President Yoon Suk-yeol and pursue reform. (12·3 비상계엄 이후 윤석열 전 대통령 부부와 12·3 내란 혐의자들에 대한 수사와 재판이 계속됐다. 지난해 대선 뒤 보수 성향의 수많은 논객이 국민의힘에 윤석열 전 대통령과의 절연과 혁신을 강하게 요구했다.)

However, the hardline members and supporters of the People Power Party elected Rep. Jang Dong-hyuk as their leader, who embodies a 'Yoon Again' orientation. Rep. Jang expelled former leader Han Dong-hoon, who had spearheaded the lifting of the emergency martial law, and steered the party towards the far right. Voters in the Seoul metropolitan area, the central region, and the Busan-Ulsan-Gyeongnam area showed extreme aversion to this line taken by Rep. Jang. (그러나 국민의힘 강성 당원과 지지층은 ‘윤 어게인’ 성향의 장동혁 대표를 선출했다. 장 대표는 비상계엄 해제에 앞장섰던 한동훈 전 대표를 제명하고 당을 극우로 몰고 갔다. 장 대표의 이런 노선에 대해 수도권과 중부권, 부·울·경 유권자들은 극도의 거부감을 보였다.)

Mayor Oh Se-hoon is one of the few remaining rational, conservative-leaning politicians within the People Power Party. Mayor Oh's electoral victory proves that his choice to distance himself from the far-right line of Rep. Jang Dong-hyuk was correct. (오세훈 시장은 국민의힘 안에 얼마 남지 않은 합리적 보수 성향의 정치인이다. 오 시장의 당선은 극우 노선의 장동혁 대표를 멀리했던 그의 선택이 옳았음을 입증한다.)

Despite these conditions, the Democratic Party failed to achieve a landslide victory because of President Lee Jae-myung and Party Leader Jung Chung-rae. The Democratic Party had earlier shown confidence that it could sweep all metropolitan and provincial government heads except for one in North Gyeongsang Province. Excessive confidence in politics leads to arrogance. Voters did not miss this point. (이런 상황에서도 민주당이 압승하지 못한 것은 이재명 대통령과 정청래 대표 때문이다. 민주당은 일찌감치 경북지사 하나만 빼고 광역단체장을 석권할 수 있다는 자신감을 보였다. 정치에서 지나친 자신감은 오만으로 이어진다. 유권자들은 바로 그 지점을 놓치지 않는다.)

What began to shake the early election landscape of a Democratic Party landslide was President Lee Jae-myung's submission of a special bill allowing the prosecution to withdraw indictments. Sensing the backlash, President Lee tried to manage the situation by saying, "Regarding the specific timing and procedures for implementation, I ask the ruling Democratic Party, after gathering public opinion and going through a deliberation process, to make the judgment." The People Power Party used the special prosecution withdrawal bill as an opportunity to rally its conservative support base. It was quite effective. Feeling the crisis, Democratic Party figures suggested, "It would be good for President Lee to state before the election that he intends to remove the prosecution's power to withdraw an indictment." It was unsuccessful. This was because President Lee's resolve to withdraw the indictment was so firm. (민주당 압승이라는 선거 초반 판도를 흔들기 시작한 것은 이재명 대통령 공소취소 특검법안 제출이었다. 역풍을 감지한 이 대통령이 “구체적인 추진 시기와 절차에 대해서는 여당인 민주당이 국민적 의견 수렴과 숙의 과정을 거쳐서 판단해달라”며 진화에 나섰다. 국민의힘은 공소취소 특검법을 보수 지지층 결집의 계기로 활용했다. 상당한 효과가 있었다. 위기감을 느낀 민주당 인사들은 “선거 전에 이 대통령이 특검의 공소취소 권한을 삭제하라는 뜻을 밝히는 게 좋겠다”고 의견을 냈다. 실패했다. 이 대통령의 공소취소 의지가 워낙 확고했기 때문이다.)

The day before the election, during a cabinet meeting where President Lee received a report from the prosecution, he said, "Anyone can make a mistake. If you do something wrong, you apologize and withdraw it." This was interpreted as President Lee ordering the prosecution to withdraw the indictment. (이 대통령은 선거 전날 국무회의에서 검찰 업무보고를 받고 “누구나 잘못할 수 있다. 잘못하면 사과하고 취소하는 것”이라고 말했다. 이 대통령이 검찰에 공소취소를 주문한 것으로 들렸다.)

President Lee sparked controversy over election interference by visiting Busan under the pretext of addressing people's livelihoods. He attempted to consolidate his support base and centrist voters with provocative expressions such as, "You must vote to avoid being dominated by the worst thugs." It was a case of 'too much of a good thing'. (이 대통령은 민생 행보를 명분으로 부산을 방문하는 등 선거 개입 논란을 일으켰다. “최악의 저질들에게 지배당하지 않기 위해 투표해야 한다”는 등 자극적인 표현으로 지지층과 중도층 결집을 시도했다. 과유불급이었다.)

President Lee's excessive actions triggered a 'check and balance' mentality among voters. Public sentiment in the Seoul metropolitan area, in particular, deteriorated rapidly in the final stages. Seoul mayoral candidate Jung Won-o was the so-called 'Lee's pick'. Candidate Jung, who had been comfortably ahead in pre-election polls and exit polls, losing is attributed to President Lee's responsibility. (이 대통령의 과잉 행보는 유권자들의 견제 심리를 자초했다. 특히 수도권 민심이 막판에 급속히 악화했다. 정원오 서울시장 후보는 이른바 ‘명픽’이었다. 선거 전 여론조사와 출구조사에서 여유 있게 앞섰던 정 후보가 낙선한 것은 이 대통령 책임이다.)

Ha Jung-woo, a candidate in the by-election for the Busan North Gap National Assembly seat and a former senior presidential secretary for AI and future strategy at the Blue House, also lost. President Lee began his political career as the mayor of Seongnam and rose to the presidency. The defeat of Seongnam mayoral candidate Kim Byung-wook, a former chief presidential secretary for political affairs at the Blue House, is a painful political defeat for President Lee. (청와대 에이아이(AI) 미래기획수석 출신 하정우 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거 후보도 낙선했다. 이 대통령은 성남시장에서 정치를 시작해 대통령 자리까지 올랐다. 청와대 정무비서관 출신 김병욱 성남시장 후보의 낙선은 이 대통령에게 뼈아픈 정치적 패배다.)

Party Leader Jung Chung-rae is also not free from responsibility. His seemingly arrogant words and actions amplified the aversion of the conservative constituency. The candidate nomination process was also not smooth, angering some party members and supporters. His focus was diverted while trying to sort out the North Jeolla Province gubernatorial election in the final stages. It seems he lost Seoul in an effort to hold onto North Jeolla. (정청래 대표도 책임을 면할 수 없다. 오만해 보이는 말과 행동으로 보수층의 거부감을 키웠다. 공천 과정도 원활하지 못해 당원과 지지층 일부의 분노를 불렀다. 막판에 전북지사 선거를 수습하느라 집중력이 흐트러졌다. 전북을 지키느라 서울을 내준 셈이다.)

Following the June 3 elections, a power struggle for party leadership among Party Leader Jung Chung-rae, Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, and lawmaker Song Young-gil within the Democratic Party is expected to intensify. Internal conflicts within the ruling camp over the next leadership could lead to public disaffection. It is a dangerous situation. (6·3 선거 이후 민주당은 정청래 대표와 김민석 국무총리, 송영길 의원 등의 당권 투쟁이 본격화할 것으로 보인다. 차기 권력을 둘러싼 집권 세력의 내부 갈등은 민심 이반을 불러올 수 있다. 위험한 상황이다.)

The People Power Party will be engulfed in internal conflict over the responsibility of leader Jang Dong-hyuk and the election of a new floor leader. However, there is hope in the mid-to-long term. Mayor Oh Se-hoon, having ascended to a fifth term as Seoul mayor, has emerged as a strong conservative candidate for the next presidential election. President-elect Han Dong-hoon has also assumed a role as an axis of conservative reform. The election is over, but politics has begun anew. (국민의힘은 장동혁 대표 책임론과 원내대표 선출을 둘러싸고 내부 갈등에 휩싸일 것이다. 그러나 중장기적으로는 희망이 생겼다. 5선 서울시장 고지에 오른 오세훈 시장은 보수의 유력한 차기 대선 주자로 떠올랐다. 한동훈 당선자도 보수 혁신의 한 축을 맡게 됐다. 선거는 끝났지만, 정치는 다시 시작이다.)

Senior Correspondent Sung Han-yong shy99@hani.co.kr (성한용 선임기자 shy99@hani.co.kr)
