item.title: Amid Talks of Xi Jinping’s Visit to North Korea… Kim Jong Un Reveals New Nuclear Facility (시진핑 방북설 와중에…김정은, 새 핵시설 공개 행보)
item.description:
North Korean leader Kim Jong Un has disclosed a new highly enriched uranium production facility, reaffirming his commitment to strengthening nuclear forces. Amid reports that Chinese President Xi Jinping’s visit to North Korea is imminent, this is interpreted as a diplomatic message asserting that “denuclearization is off the table” and solidifying the country’s status as a nuclear-armed state. <<> On the 4th, the Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) reported that Chairman Kim visited a newly operational nuclear material production plant the previous day and reiterated his determination to bolster nuclear forces. The agency stated, “Chairman Kim assessed that over the past five years, the production capacity of weapons-grade nuclear material has surpassed twice the previous level, and he decided on a new five-year plan to strengthen nuclear forces at the 9th Party Congress held earlier this year.” <<> Kim also convened an important meeting on strengthening nuclear forces that day, emphasizing, “We will exponentially enhance the national nuclear force” and “Thoroughly exercising the status of a nuclear-armed state is our immutable political and military stance.” KCNA also released photos showing densely arranged uranium enrichment centrifuges, a control room, and pipelines. <<> Previously, three locations for North Korea’s uranium enrichment facilities were known: Yongbyon in North Pyongan Province, Kangson in Nampo, and Kusong in North Pyongan Province. Experts believe the plant Kim visited is likely a newly built uranium enrichment facility within Yongbyon. <<> Hong Min, a senior research fellow at the Korea Institute for National Unification, based on the International Atomic Energy Agency’s (IAEA) analysis that a newly constructed enrichment building in Yongbyon, started in 2024, was recently completed, analyzed: “It seems highly probable that operations have begun at this new uranium enrichment facility building within the Yongbyon complex, rather than at a ‘fourth location’ beyond the known three.” <<> Experts noted that Kim’s showcasing of the new nuclear facility and mass production capabilities underscores the message to the international community that “denuclearization is no longer a negotiating topic,” and pointed out the timing of the disclosure as noteworthy. <<> This is the third time North Korea has publicly reported Kim Jong Un’s visit to a uranium enrichment facility, following September 2024 and January of last year. Senior researcher Hong Min explained, “The first public disclosure in 2024 came about 50 days before the U.S. presidential election, and the second in January 2025 coincided with the launch of the second Trump administration in the U.S. This time, it followed last month’s U.S.-China summit and the joint statement from the Quad (security dialogue involving the U.S., Japan, Australia, and India) foreign ministers’ meeting. In response to (U.S. and Chinese leaders and Quad foreign ministers) reaffirming the goal of ‘North Korea’s denuclearization,’ it’s an attempt to establish ‘denuclearization impossibility’ as a fait accompli.” Last month, when the Quad foreign ministers’ joint statement explicitly mentioned “North Korea’s denuclearization,” North Korea’s Foreign Ministry denounced it as “interference in sovereignty.” <<> When the U.S. raises the goal of “North Korea’s denuclearization,” Kim Jong Un aimed to clearly convey the message that “even if North-U.S. dialogue resumes, denuclearization will never happen.” In its coverage of Kim’s inspection, North Korea emphasized nuclear possession as “a sacred right granted by the constitution.” <<> There is also an interpretation that this move targets China, given reports that President Xi Jinping’s visit to North Korea is imminent. President Xi is expected to visit around July 11, the 65th anniversary of the North Korea-China Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation, and Mutual Assistance. By showcasing nuclear capabilities ahead of Xi’s visit, Kim intends to preemptively prevent denuclearization from becoming an agenda item at the North Korea-China summit. <<> Jang Yong-seok, a visiting researcher at the Seoul National University Institute for Peace and Unification, analyzed: “If President Xi Jinping visits at this time, the message would be to clarify that ‘China is the manager of the Korean Peninsula situation,’ but Chairman Kim Jong Un is sending a message to Xi not to bring up the denuclearization agenda and not to consider military or diplomatic interference.” <<> The South Korean government responded to Kim Jong Un’s inspection, stating, “North Korea’s nuclear activities are a clear violation of multiple UN Security Council resolutions and a challenge to international peace, security, and the non-proliferation regime.” A foreign ministry official said that day, “The government maintains the goal of complete denuclearization of the Korean Peninsula and will continue efforts to make substantial progress in resolving the North Korean nuclear issue in close coordination with the international community.” <<> Senior Reporter Park Min-hee: minggu@hani.co.kr (김정은 북한 국무위원장이 새 고농축 우라늄 생산 공장을 공개하며 핵 무력 강화 의지를 거듭 강조했다. 시진핑 중국 국가주석의 방북 임박설이 나오는 상황에서 ‘비핵화는 없다’며 핵보유국 지위를 공고히 하려는 외교적 메시지를 발신한 것으로 해석된다.)

item.title: President Lee Criticizes Election Commission: "Held Accountable for Electoral Management Loopholes" (이 대통령 “선거 관리 허점, 책임 물어야” 선관위 질타)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung expressed "deep regret" on the 4th regarding the "ballot paper shortage incident," stating, "In a democratic republic, it is unacceptable to have such inexplicable loopholes in election management, which should be above all else." (이재명 대통령이 4일 ‘투표용지 부족 사태’와 관련해 “민주공화국에서 무엇보다 철저해야 할 선거 관리에 납득하기 어려운 허점이 드러난 데 대해 매우 큰 유감을 표한다”고 말했다.)

During a meeting with senior presidential secretaries held at the Blue House, President Lee said, "All state agencies have a duty to make thorough preparations to ensure no gaps exist in the process of exercising the people's sacred political rights." He criticized the National Election Commission (NEC) for the situation that occurred during the previous day's June 3 local elections, where voters in some areas, including Jamsil in Seoul, were unable to vote or had to wait due to a shortage of ballot papers. (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 수석보좌관 회의에서 “모든 국가기관은 국민의 신성한 참정권 행사 과정에서 조금의 빈틈이 없도록 만반의 준비를 해야 할 책무가 있다”며 이렇게 말했다. 전날 치러진 6·3 지방선거 투표 진행 중 서울 잠실 등 일부 지역에서 투표용지 부족으로 투표를 하지 못해 돌아가거나 대기하는 사태가 벌어진 것에 대해 중앙선거관리위원회(중앙선관위)를 질타한 것이다.)

President Lee stated, "Relevant agencies must use all the responsibilities and powers vested in the executive branch to clearly determine the cause of the problem and hold accountable those who are responsible. I hope reliable and appropriate measures are put in place to ensure that political rights are never undermined again." (이 대통령은 “관계기관은 행정부가 가진 책임과 권한을 모두 사용해 문제 발생 이유를 명확히 밝히고, 책임질 게 있으면 책임을 물어야 한다”며 “참정권이 훼손되는 일이 다시는 발생하지 않도록 신뢰할 만한 적절한 대책을 마련해주길 바란다”고 했다.)

Regarding President Lee's remarks, Senior Spokesperson Kang Yoo-jung explained, "This does not mean direct sanctions against the NEC. It signifies that the NEC must take responsible measures to ensure political rights are not shaken." (이 대통령 발언에 대해 강유정 수석대변인은 “선관위에 대한 직접 제재를 의미하는 건 아니”라며 “참정권이 흔들리지 않도록 선관위가 책임 있는 조치를 다해야 한다는 의미”라고 설명했다.)

Both the ruling and opposition parties strongly criticized the NEC. Jo Seung-rae, general election campaign chief of the Democratic Party of Korea, said during a press briefing at the National Assembly, "I believe we need to consider the fate of the NEC Secretary-General, who is responsible for the commission's administration." (여야는 중앙선관위를 강하게 비판했다. 조승래 더불어민주당 총괄선대본부장은 이날 국회 기자간담회에서 “선관위 행정을 책임지고 있는 사무총장의 거취까지도 고민해야 한다고 생각한다”고 했다.)

People Power Party floor leader Song Eon-seok convened a general meeting of lawmakers at the National Assembly, demanding an emergency parliamentary investigation into the ballot paper shortage and calling for the resignations of NEC Secretary-General Heo Cheol-hoon and Seoul Metropolitan Election Commission Chairperson Oh Min-seok. However, unlike the previous day, Rep. Jang Dong-hyuk and the party leadership did not further mention a "re-election." Seoul Mayor-elect Oh Se-hoon, of the People Power Party, said after his victory speech, "We must approach this with the determination to fundamentally innovate the NEC, as if disbanding it and creating a new one. Ultimately, the president bears responsibility." (송언석 국민의힘 원내대표는 국회에서 의원총회를 열고 투표용지 부족 사태 관련 긴급 국정조사 진행을 민주당에 요구하고, 허철훈 중앙선관위 사무총장과 오민석 서울시선관위원장의 사퇴를 촉구했다. 다만 전날 ‘재선거’를 요구한 장동혁 대표와 국민의힘 지도부는 이날 재선거에 대해 추가로 언급하지 않았다. 국민의힘 소속 오세훈 서울시장 당선자는 당선 인사 뒤 “선관위를 해체하고 새로 만든다는 심정으로 근본부터 혁신하겠다는 각오로 임해야 한다”며 “결과적으로 모두 대통령 책임”이라고 했다.)

Meanwhile, the NEC issued a statement saying, "We will establish and operate a fact-finding committee composed mainly of external experts to thoroughly investigate issues, causes, and responsibility, and disclose all results to the public." (한편 중앙선관위는 이날 입장문을 내어 “외부 전문가 위주로 구성한 진상규명위원회를 설치·운영해 문제점과 원인, 책임을 철저히 따져 국민께 모든 결과를 소상히 밝히겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk "Holding onto Party Power"…Han Dong-hoon Directly Hits "Lacks Dignity and Competence" (‘당권 사수’ 장동혁에…한동훈 “품격·실력 없다” 직격)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk, the leader of the People Power Party, stated regarding the June 3 local elections, "I will not ignore the heavy responsibility given to me and will seek a new path forward with party members." This is interpreted as dismissing growing calls within the party for him to make a decision on his position after election results that only managed to retain four metropolitan mayoral positions (Seoul, Daegu, South Gyeongsang, North Gyeongsang). (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 6·3 지방선거와 관련해 “제게 주어진 막중한 책임을 외면하지 않고 당원들과 함께 나아갈 새 길을 찾겠다”고 했다. 광역단체장 선거 4곳(서울·대구·경남·경북) 수성에 그친 선거 결과를 놓고 당내 거취 결단을 압박하는 목소리가 커지고 있으나 이를 일축한 것으로 해석된다.)

After the victory of Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party's candidate for Seoul mayor, was confirmed on the 4th, leader Jang wrote on Facebook, "This election was difficult in every way, but we kept the spark of hope alive." He added, "This must be the people’s command to protect their lives and defend the Republic of Korea against the arrogant and immoral Lee Jae-myung and the Democratic Party. Citizens, please fight alongside us. Comrade party members, do not lose courage." This stance was seen as an expression of Jang's determination to hold onto party leadership. Floor leader Yoon Jae-ok also assessed the election results positively at a general meeting of lawmakers held at the National Assembly on the same day, saying, "The people have perhaps opened their hearts to us a little." (장 대표는 4일 오세훈 국민의힘 서울시장 후보의 당선이 확정된 뒤 페이스북에 “모든 상황이 어려웠던 이번 선거였지만, 우리는 희망의 불씨를 지켜냈다”며 이렇게 적었다. 그는 이어 “오만하고 무도한 이재명과 민주당에 맞서서, 국민의 삶을 지키고 대한민국을 지키라는 국민의 명령일 것”이라며 “국민 여러분, 함께 싸워주십시오. 당원 동지 여러분, 용기를 잃지 말아주십시오”라고 덧붙였다. 이런 입장은 장 대표의 당권 사수 의지로 풀이됐다. 송언석 원내대표도 이날 국회에서 열린 의원총회에서 “국민께서 다소나마 저희에게 마음을 열어주신 것 아닌가”라며 이번 선거 결과를 긍정적으로 평가했다.)

Contrary to such self-justifying interpretations by the party leadership, the internal atmosphere within the party is cold. (당 지도부의 이런 자위적 풀이와는 달리 당 내부 분위기는 싸늘하다.)

Yoo Eui-dong, who won the by-election for the Pyeongtaek B district in Gyeonggi Province, said on SBS radio that morning, "I believe Chairman Jang will naturally be reflecting on his position." Lawmaker Ahn Sang-hoon wrote on Facebook that day, "The shocking expulsion of former leader Han Dong-hoon by the Jang Dong-hyuk leadership, and Mayor Oh Se-hoon, who protected Seoul by keeping his distance from that leadership—this is the signal for the reconstruction of rational conservatism. The party leadership should quickly decide their position." (경기 평택을 국회의원 재선거에서 승리한 유의동 당선자는 이날 오전 에스비에스(SBS) 라디오에서 “(장 대표가) 당연히 (거취) 고민을 하실 것이라고 생각한다”고 했다. 안상훈 의원은 이날 페이스북에 “장동혁 지도부가 황당 제명한 한동훈 전 대표의 의회 입성, 장동혁 지도부와 거리를 둬서 서울 지킨 오세훈 시장. 합리적 보수 재건의 신호탄”이라며 “당 지도부는 거취를 속히 정해야 할 것”이라고 적었다.)

Lawmaker Kim Yong-tae also said, "I hope this ballot shortage incident does not become a rotten lifeline for the party leadership to evade responsibility for the election defeat." Lawmaker Park Jeong-hoon met with reporters and stated, "The main reason for the Seoul mayoral election win is that the party leadership had absolutely no involvement. For the party to be reborn as one loved by the people, this local election must become a significant turning point." (김용태 의원도 “이번 투표용지 부족 사태가 당 지도부의 선거 패배 책임을 회피하는 썩은 동아줄이 되지 않기를 바란다”고 했다. 박정훈 의원은 기자들과 만나 “서울시장 선거 승리는 당 지도부가 전혀 관여하지 않은 것이 주요 원인”이라며 “국민에게 사랑받는 정당으로 태어나기 위해선 이번 지방선거가 중요한 변곡점이 돼야 한다”고 했다.)

In a Telegram chatroom for People Power Party lawmakers, Lawmaker Yun Han-hong criticized, "Because of the party's mistakes, the local election candidates suffered hardships they shouldn't have had to endure." However, at the general meeting of lawmakers held that day, there were no public demands for Jang's resignation. A lawmaker told *The Hankyoreh*, "Since Chairman Jang was absent (due to health reasons), no such discussion came up, but throughout this election, his hardline conservative stance made the overall election difficult. Calls for his resignation will naturally grow." (국민의힘 의원들이 모인 텔레그램 방에서는 윤한홍 의원이 “당의 잘못으로 지방선거 출마자들이 안 해도 될 고생을 했다”고 성토했다. 다만, 이날 열린 의원총회에선 장 대표를 향한 공개 사퇴 요구가 없었다. 한 의원은 한겨레에 “(건강상의 이유로 불참한 장 대표가) 없으니 얘기가 안 나왔지만, 이번 선거 내내 장 대표의 강경 보수 행보로 전체 선거가 어려웠다. 자연스럽게 사퇴론은 커질 수밖에 없다”고 했다.)

Han Dong-hoon, who was elected as an independent in the Busan North Gap by-election for the National Assembly, directly targeted Jang on his first day in office. (한동훈 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거 무소속 당선자는 당선 첫날 연 기자회견에서 장 대표를 직격했다.)

The elected Han stated, "The words and actions of those in power within the party do not match the dignity or competence that a conservative party should have. It's time for some reflection and to set the right direction." After entering the National Assembly, the elected Han also indicated his intention to act as a focal point for reorganizing the conservative camp, positioning himself in opposition to Chairman Jang. He said, "I feel that among the People Power Party lawmakers, there are very many who sympathize with the cause or principle of rebuilding conservatism." (한 당선자는 “당권파들의 언행들은 보수정당이 가져온 품격이나 실력에 맞지 않는다”며 “이제는 좀 반성하고 방향을 제대로 잡아야 한다”고 했다. 한 당선자는 국회에 들어온 뒤 장 대표의 대척점에서 보수 진영 재편의 구심점 구실을 하겠다는 뜻도 밝혔다. 그는 “(국민의힘 의원들 가운데) 보수 재건의 명분이나 대의에 공감하는 분들이 굉장히 많다고 느끼고 있다”고 말했다.)

The elected Han is expected to continue clashing with Chairman Jang over his potential return to the People Power Party. Chairman Jang is extremely negative about Han rejoining the party. A source close to the elected Han said, "For now, the elected Han is refraining from commenting on matters like rejoining the party." The elected Han will take part in the National Assembly's plenary session on the 5th, take the oath of office as a lawmaker, and begin his parliamentary activities. (한 당선자는 국민의힘 복당을 두고 장 대표와 계속 갈등할 것으로 보인다. 장 대표는 한 당선자의 복당에 극히 부정적이다. 한 당선자 쪽 관계자는 “일단 복당 등에 대해서는 한 당선자가 말을 아끼는 분위기”라고 했다. 한 당선자는 5일 국회 본회의에 출석해 의원 선서를 하고 의정 활동을 시작한다.)

Reporting by Kim Hae-jung sea@hani.co.kr Jo Hee-yeon choh@hani.co.kr (김해정 기자 sea@hani.co.kr  조희연 기자 choh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: DP in battlegrounds, no conclusion yet on special counsel bill for manipulated indictments (접전지 진 민주, 조작기소 특검법에 “아직 결론 없다”)
item.description:
With the June 3 local elections concluded, attention is turning to the Democratic Party of Korea’s handling of the ‘special counsel bill for manipulated indictments,’ which was postponed until after the elections. The bill is considered by many inside and outside the party as one of the factors behind the party’s defeats in battleground regions, including the Seoul mayoral, Daegu mayoral, and South Gyeongsang gubernatorial races. <<> Democratic Party Secretary General Cho Seung-rae, speaking at a press briefing at the National Assembly on the 4th, was cautious when asked about plans to push forward with the special counsel bill for manipulated indictments, stating, “We have not yet reached a conclusion. We need to discuss how to handle the bill.” The Democratic Party proposed the special counsel bill on April 30, which effectively grants the special counsel the authority to dismiss prosecutions. The bill includes a clause stating, “The special counsel shall carry out the task of maintaining prosecution (including decisions on whether to maintain the prosecution) for cases transferred to it.” Amidst criticism, the party postponed discussions on the timing, procedures, and content until after the local elections. At the time, Daegu mayoral candidate Kim Boo-kyum expressed concerns over the bill’s introduction. <<> Within the party, there are views that caution is needed in handling the special counsel bill, given that the election results have confirmed a significant sentiment to check the government and ruling party. One lawmaker said, “The special counsel itself should be launched quickly,” but added, “Looking at the election results, shouldn’t we consider more aspects regarding the ‘dismissal of prosecution’ clause? It seems that clause should be removed.” Another lawmaker commented, “I believe the push for the unreasonable special counsel bill for manipulated indictments influenced the consolidation of the conservative camp in the local elections.” <<> However, there are also predictions that it won’t be easy to control the pace, given that the presidential office is reportedly strongly determined on the special counsel for manipulated indictments. A Democratic Party lawmaker said, “Among the current contenders for party leadership, there is no one who can openly oppose the special counsel bill—who would dare to speak up?” <<> Reporter Go Kyung-joo goh@hani.co.kr (6·3 지방선거가 끝난 가운데, 더불어민주당이 선거 뒤로 미뤄둔 ‘조작기소 특검법’ 처리에 관심이 쏠리고 있다. 조작기소 특검법은 당 안팎에서 서울시장과 대구시장, 경남지사 등 접전지역 선거 패배의 원인 가운데 하나로 꼽히고 있다.)

item.title: Oh Se-hoon's 'Independent Path' Makes Him First-Ever 5-Term Seoul Mayor... Solidifying a Springboard for Presidential Bid? (‘독자 노선’ 오세훈, 사상 첫 5선 서울시장…대권 발판 굳히나)
item.description:
Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party candidate for Seoul mayor, successfully overtook Jeong Won-oh, the Democratic Party candidate, in the final vote counting on the morning of the 4th, achieving the historic feat of becoming the first-ever five-term Seoul mayor. Having secured a dramatic comeback victory, attention now turns to what path he will take, both as mayor and as a potential presidential contender. (오세훈 국민의힘 서울시장 후보가 4일 오전 막판 개표에서 정원오 더불어민주당 후보에게 역전에 성공하면서 사상 첫 서울시장 5선 고지에 올랐다. 드라마틱한 역전승을 거둔 그가 시장으로서는 물론 잠재적 대선 주자로서 어떤 행보를 보일지가 관심사로 떠올랐다.)

After delivering a victory speech at his election campaign in Jongno-gu that morning, the elected Oh immediately returned to Seoul City Hall. Upon arriving at the building, he said, "I deeply thank the citizens for once again giving me the opportunity to work even harder for the next four years." Welcomed by employees lining the lobby, he received a bouquet and added, "I've returned to the same spot after 38 days. I briefly thought I might not be able to come back, so I'm grateful to see you all again." (오세훈 당선자는 이날 오전 종로구 선거캠프에서 당선 인사를 한 뒤 곧바로 서울시청으로 복귀했다. 청사에 도착한 그는 “다시 한번 4년 동안 더 열심히 뛸 기회를 주신 시민 여러분께 깊이 감사드린다”고 했다. 로비에 도열한 직원들의 환영 속에 꽃다발을 건네받고는 “38일 만에 제자리로 돌아왔다. 못 돌아올 수도 있다는 생각을 잠시 했는데 다시 뵙게 돼 감사하다”고 했다.)

Throughout the campaign period, the elected Oh kept his distance from the People Power Party leadership and put real estate and housing issues at the forefront. He emphasized the jeonse and monthly rent crisis, reconstruction and redevelopment, and expanding housing supply, attempting to differentiate himself from candidate Jeong. By repeatedly delivering messages targeting Seoul's rising home prices and housing insecurity, he sought to consolidate the conservative base and appeal to moderate voters. (오 당선자는 선거운동 기간 내내 국민의힘 지도부와 거리를 두고 부동산·주거 문제를 전면에 내세웠다. 전월세난, 재건축·재개발, 주택 공급 확대를 강조하며 정 후보와의 차별화를 시도했다. 서울의 집값과 주거 불안을 겨냥한 메시지를 반복하며 보수층 결집과 중도층 공략에 나섰다.)

However, in the final stages, the momentum seemed to stall due to consecutive incidents: the controversy over missing rebar at the GTX-A Samsung Station and the collapse of the Seosomun Overpass. Both issues dealt a blow to the 'Safe Seoul' image that the elected Oh had promoted as mayor. Regarding the missing rebar, a blame game erupted over whether Seoul City had promptly identified and reported the structural defect during project management, while the ruling party attacked, calling it "a major case of negligence threatening citizen safety." (그러나 막판에 수도권광역급행철도(GTX)-A 삼성역 철근 누락 논란과 서소문 고가차도 붕괴 사고가 잇따라 터지며 상승세에 제동이 걸리는 듯했다. 두 사안 모두 오 당선자가 시장으로서 내세워온 ‘안전한 서울’ 이미지에 타격을 줬다. 철근 누락은 서울시가 사업 관리 과정에서 구조적 결함을 제때 파악하고 보고했는지를 놓고 책임 공방이 벌어졌고, 여당은 “시민 안전을 위협한 중대 부실”이라며 공세를 폈다.)

The collapse of the Seosomun Overpass also had a significant impact, being a human casualty incident that occurred right before the election. Key issues included whether road and railway controls were implemented promptly after abnormalities were detected during demolition and whether the reporting and decision-making systems of Seoul City and related agencies functioned properly. Nevertheless, the elected Oh's upward trend is assessed to have overcome these late-stage setbacks. In political circles, it is evaluated that the 'real estate public sentiment' swung in his favor, enabling the comeback. Among the seven 'Han River Belt' districts (Gangdong, Gwangjin, Dongjak, Mapo, Seongdong, Yeongdeungpo, Yongsan), he led in five, excluding Seongdong and Mapo—where candidate Jeong served as district mayor for 12 years. A lawmaker who assisted the elected Oh remarked, "He was ahead in terms of character, and the real estate sentiment that shook the Han River Belt tipped the scales. He solidified a moderate reformist conservative image by keeping distance from [party leader] Jang Dong-hyuk. This is Oh Se-hoon's victory, not the party's." (서소문 고가차도 붕괴도 선거 막판 발생한 인명 사고라 파장이 컸다. 철거 과정에서 이상 징후 발생 뒤 도로와 철도 통제가 제때 이뤄졌는지, 서울시와 관계 기관의 보고·판단 체계가 제대로 작동했는지가 쟁점으로 떠올랐다. 그럼에도 오 당선자의 상승 흐름은 막판 악재를 넘어선 것으로 평가된다. 정치권에서는 ‘부동산 민심’이 쏠리면서 역전에 성공했다는 평가가 나온다. ‘한강벨트’ 7곳(강동·광진·동작·마포·성동·영등포·용산) 중 정 후보가 12년간 구청장을 지낸 성동과 마포를 뺀 5곳에서 앞섰다. 오 당선자를 도운 한 의원은 “인물론으로 앞선데다 한강벨트를 흔든 부동산 민심이 쏠린 결과”라며 “장동혁 대표와 거리를 두며 중도개혁보수 이미지를 굳혔다. 당이 아닌 오세훈의 승리”라고 했다.)

The path ahead for Oh Se-hoon's fifth-term administration is not expected to be smooth. Following the local elections, out of the 118 seats in the Seoul Metropolitan Council, the Democratic Party secured 81 seats and the People Power Party 37, shifting the majority party. When the new council is inaugurated, conflicts with the city council over major administrative issues such as budgets, ordinances, and personnel hearings seem inevitable. (5기 오세훈 시정의 앞길이 순탄치만은 않을 전망이다. 지방선거로 서울시의회 118석 가운데 민주당이 81석, 국민의힘이 37석을 차지하며 다수당이 바뀌었다. 새 시의회가 출범하면 예산·조례·인사청문 등 주요 시정 현안을 둘러싸고 시의회와의 충돌이 불가피할 것으로 보인다.)

Meanwhile, the elected Oh's position and moves, following his dramatic turnaround in the key battleground of Seoul, are also drawing attention regarding the People Power Party's leadership and competition among potential next presidential candidates. Having demanded a step back from leader Jang Dong-hyuk and pursuing an independent path, his five-term success has strengthened his footing as a conservative presidential candidate. He is expected to seek a coalition of moderate conservative reformists, along with former lawmaker Yoo Seong-min, lawmaker Ahn Cheol-soo, and Reformist Party leader Lee Jun-seok, while charting his course as a presidential hopeful. (한편 최대 승부처 서울에서 역전극을 펼친 오 당선자의 입지와 행보는 국민의힘 당권이나 차기 대선 주자 경쟁과 관련해서도 주목받는다. 장 대표에게 2선 후퇴까지 요구하며 거리를 둔 독자 노선으로 5선에 성공하면서 보수 쪽 대선 주자로서 발판도 다지게 됐다. 유승민 전 의원, 안철수 의원, 이준석 개혁신당 대표 등과 함께 중도보수개혁 연대를 모색하며 대선 주자로서의 진로를 모색할 것으로 관측된다.)
